| | Dear Friend,

Learning about how early Christians worshipped and prayed, faced persecution and hardship, and settled theological disputes enriches our understanding of the faith. These lessons are especially important today, as Christians face increasing opposition from the culture.

But, beyond reading the New Testament and some of the stories of early Christian martyrs, it can be daunting to figure out how to proceed. The complicated history of imperial Rome, along with the foreign names and locations featured in early Christian history, can make understanding the most important historical points difficult.

To uncover this fascinating history, we've produced our online course, "[Ancient Christianity](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=ccfdb8c796c14cea85adbd4f58866182&_e=BgRbRXxJGJKn33wvgCKECkPc9ehDdKGlgYDcbmF02bdgWuJC8EvTtX9RJ9wKtwLkEjOV3WexYoemLGO8m9f_w_bEZmv7y2Z37COtg12eAaPeIvew84QQC_ye_y-Kw15dP_lD4l75oc5BlzQeSrRa7wZafrNs-PwT3_RtgafJYQoa0PkBWakOw3ohGW0gt7wfMJupcGub01glmEI1R0VVtD1c82b3MV4XhL1HkYRU_Dnra3QKuLB3jSczOROFG71yaGaf4TRksF8uPUJrOdTEhEUTsjpwpC6VntdVALIb0MwtbpVHTXBmUIs6b2Q5x6ipxsNMb4V01UH3_jVzP2tegGYi2MHcuzbtAtxHadsjcrK-S6laT_1ma1b2PgNzxaN1hpWeF3Y-Ojh041MeKIu9oqRBhIE3kI-52U021u6WVkQzQiT1Kc_D6cvBoK5buMJw)," now available on DVD.

In this course, Professor Kenneth Calvert is your guide through the first four centuries of Christianity as he explains the remarkable ways the new faith transformed the Roman world.

Would you help support this course so we can make it available to millions of Americans for free? As a token of our appreciation for your support, we'll send you a copy of our beautiful DVD Box Set for any donations of $100 or more.

body:
The bottom line is that opponents of voting rights could easily enact many of the proposed policies from Project 2025. We're focused on the changes to voting and our elections, but there's no doubt that this plan would radically alter our country and our lives into a mix of our inequitable past and an unrecognizable autocracy. The loss of rights might well be irreversible.
We cannot stand by and let Project 2025 become reality. RUSH $25 or more right now to make sure every voter knows about the dangerous consequences of this plan before they vote >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=082524_3&amount=25]
Voter Action Project Logo [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-weekly?refcode=082524_3&amount=25]
Vox - Project 2025: The myths and the facts [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=082524_3&amount=25]
There's been a lot of talk about the Heritage Foundation's "Project 2025", Team. It's time for the truth.
Project 2025 is a detailed and specific plan for what the next Republican president could ( or in the eyes of some, should ) do with his power, including the preparation needed to put the plan into action. Organized by the Heritage Foundation, a right-wing, dark money, inside-the-beltway, anti-voting think tank , and advised by more than 100 conservative groups, Project 2025 has put forth a 922-page list of policy recommendations, going agency by agency in the federal government.
This is not an unattainable "wish list" -- this is carefully crafted to be a list of things the next president’s appointees really can do , put together by many people who served in top posts under Trump last time and could well do so again. Basically, it’s an attempt to make the second Trump term way more organized and effective than the first.
This is a good place to mention that Project 2025 is also collecting a database of names of conservatives who have already pledged loyalty to Donald Trump and could easily take jobs in his potential second term, willing to start executing this plan on day one.
Already heard enough and are willing to help us educate voters across the country about this dangerous and anti-democracy plan? Pitch in $25 or whatever you can now >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=082524_3&amount=25]
Project 2025 covers a lot of different things, but basically falls into three buckets:
➜ Expanding the power of the president. Various pieces of the plan attempt to consolidate executive branch power in the hands of the president and his political appointees and away from nonpartisan civil service employees and Congress. For example, Donald Trump himself could be directing voter suppression efforts through the Department of Justice.
➜ Long-term conservative policy priorities. Slashing regulations on businesses, especially in regards to the environment. Ending climate change mitigation efforts. Reducing programs to help the poor, like food programs or educational requirements. Eradicating civil rights protections, including access to the ballot and our ability to vote. The list goes on, but if you've heard it from a conservative politician over the last forty years, it's likely in this plan.
➜ An extreme religious agenda. Further federal restrictions on abortion access. New, possibly expansive restrictions on contraception coverage. Outlawing pornography and imprisoning members of that industry. Banning LGBTQ books in libraries. Rolling back or ending LGBTQ programs in schools.
Project 2025 would fundamentally alter just about every aspect of American life . We must make sure every American is aware of what their vote might mean and how this expansive blueprint would truly impact themselves, their friends, and their family before it is time for them to cast a ballot.
Fuel our efforts to spread the word and educate voters about these dangerous plans with $25 or more today >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=082524_3&amount=25]

# [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=1822%2E135344%2E8A5AM4)

Friend --
The presidential race has understandably received a lot of attention over the past few weeks. It has my attention as well.
But I am writing to ask you to return your focus to the Senate today.
Because if Kamala Harris wins, she won't be able to get anything meaningful done without a Democratic Senate.
And if Trump wins, we will need a Democratic Senate to stop his worst impulses.
Both outcomes run through Michigan and this race. This is going to be one of the most expensive and competitive races in the country, the polls show it starts off extremely close, and I won't be able to win this alone. Republicans know that too. It's why they are pouring extraordinary sums of money into the state to defeat us.
Such a large amount of the money we raise comes in response to emails like this one, so I am asking you not to lose sight of this race and its importance.

subject: Hard work, determination, and persistence

Friend: When I was growing up, I never could have imagined that I'd run for elected office one day – let alone become the first computer programmer and the first former synagogue president ever elected to the Senate.
As the granddaughter of Jewish immigrants and the daughter of a World War II veteran, I was surrounded by loved ones who taught me the values of hard work, determination, and persistence – and I've carried these with me my entire life.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/91520425/494131335/1398942472?amounts=250,100,50,25,5&refcode=jtk4592-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODI5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkYzE3MTUzNy00NzYzLWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkYmZjNGIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=7iulgUycwVzNM4YD1F02E5pOVEc-Xpah0DOJbz3dxHQ=)
I carried those values with me when I was working as a cocktail waitress at Caesars Palace to pay for college, becoming the first in my family to graduate. I carried them with me when I was working as a computer programmer in a male-dominated field.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/91520426/494131336/1398942472?amounts=250,100,50,25,5&refcode=jtk4592-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODI5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkYzE3MTUzNy00NzYzLWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkYmZjNGIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=7iulgUycwVzNM4YD1F02E5pOVEc-Xpah0DOJbz3dxHQ=)
I carried those values with me during my first-ever campaign for Congress in 2016, when I flipped a highly competitive district from red to blue,**and in 2018, when I defeated a Republican incumbent against all odds – becoming the second woman senator in Nevada's history.**
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/91520427/494131337/1398942472?amounts=250,100,50,25,5&refcode=jtk4592-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODI5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkYzE3MTUzNy00NzYzLWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkYmZjNGIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=7iulgUycwVzNM4YD1F02E5pOVEc-Xpah0DOJbz3dxHQ=)
To this day, those values of hard work, determination, and persistence fuel my fight to advocate for working families and bring much-needed progress to the lives of all Nevadans.
**But right now,_CNN_ is calling me the most vulnerable woman in the Senate – and _The Cook Political Report_ is calling Nevada the "most perilous" battleground for Democrats.**
The GOP will come after me with everything they've got, and I simply cannot fight back without your grassroots support. **[So please, friend, will you contribute $5 or more today to help me defend my seat and protect our Democratic Senate majority?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/91520428/494131338/1398942472?amounts=250,100,50,25,5&amount=5&refcode=jtk4592-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODI5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkYzE3MTUzNy00NzYzLWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkYmZjNGIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=7iulgUycwVzNM4YD1F02E5pOVEc-Xpah0DOJbz3dxHQ=)**

Republicans oust leadership in meeting Chair Williams calls ‘fraudulent’

**August 25, 2024** **SUNDAY NEWS DIGEST** **By Heidi Ganahl**
| | Dear Readers,

In this week's Sunday News Digest, we dive into this weekend's meeting that led to the highly contested ousting of Colorado GOP's leadership -- events that are sure to be litigated in coming days.

Held in a church in Brighton, Colorado, 77 state GOP central committee members attended in person, and another 105 participated via proxy. The gathering focused on the leadership of Chairman Dave Williams, Vice Chairwoman Hope Scheppelman, and Secretary Anna Ferguson, who were all voted out of their positions amid claims of mismanagement and divisive tactics.

The assembly was chaired by Richard Holtorf, a state representative from Washington County, who has been a vocal critic of Williams. The soon to be contested meeting saw the installation of Eli Bremer as the new chairman, with Brita Horn as vice chairwoman and Kevin McCarney as secretary.

The meeting’s legality is being questioned due to procedural anomalies and the interpretation of the party’s bylaws regarding the removal of officers. Specifically, there was debate over whether a 3/5ths majority of all Central Committee members or just those present was required to validate the leadership changes.

If the results stand, the new chairman, Eli Bremer, said he would quickly move to endorse all Republican candidates for the general election and open a new party office. The legality is expected to be reviewed and decided by the courts and the RNC soon. [Read the full article here](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), reported by our very own editor/publisher Brian Porter, who was live at the meeting.
Warm regards, Heidi Ganahl

body:

http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/os6Ty4-WNN

Friend,

In the
2024 Election, it's not a matter of right versus left - it's a
matter of right versus wrong.

Morality
is on the ballot...

...and
the Institute for Faith & Culture is working hard to register
thousands of new Christian voters before this year's election.

Friend,
will you stand with the Institute for Faith & Culture ... and
believers across America ... as you pledge to VOTE YOUR FAITH in
the 2024 Election?

Sign the
pledge to VOTE YOUR FAITH

God's
hand is evident in the founding and shaping of America. Our
Founding Fathers were profoundly influenced by biblical
principles and our Judeo-Christian heritage is woven in every
founding document.

Yet, the
world wants Christians to believe that our faith has no place in
the public square.

You and I
know the truth: the very heart of America is rooted in the
timeless truths of Scripture!

Above:
The Institute for Faith & Culture prepares young believers for
leadership every year. Let's pray for the next generation as they
confront a hostile and secular world and bring the light of
Christ to their campuses!

Friend,
today America's godly heritage is under attack - and the
Institute for Faith & Culture, the non-profit ministry I'm proud
to lead, is pushing back against the anti-Christian forces at
play in America every day.

In this
important year, the Institute for Faith & Culture is registering
thousands of voters and ensuring they understand their civic and
Biblical responsibility to vote...

...because life, religious liberty, and righteousness in our
nation are too important to remain on the sidelines.

Friend, I
hope you'll join us in igniting a NATIONWIDE revival in support
of biblical values! Pledge today to VOTE YOUR FAITH in the 2024
Election.

When you
sign the "Vote Your Faith" pledge, you're not just making a
personal commitment - you're joining a movement of believers who
are determined to be the salt and light our country so
desperately needs.

That's
why my request today is so urgent ... and so important.

Sign the
pledge to VOTE YOUR FAITH

Secularism and moral relativism are eroding our shared values and
our nation's culture. The next generation is leaving the faith in
droves, the Church's influence on culture has waned, and a time
of moral chaos and spiritual darkness has all but taken over our
country.

America
is at a crossroads, and the decisions we make in the coming years
will have far-reaching consequences.

By
signing this special pledge to VOTE YOUR FAITH, you are joining a
growing movement of believers who refuse to be silent, who are
determined to make a difference, and who are committed to
advancing Christian principles in every area of our society.

Please
stand with the Institute of Faith & Culture and THOUSANDS of
believers across the country, as you pledge to VOTE YOUR FAITH in
the 2024 election.

Thank you
for your support. Please join me in praying ceaselessly for
America's future.

Lauren
Cooley
Executive
Director
Institute
for Faith & Culture

Sign the
pledge to VOTE YOUR FAITH

5555
North Federal Hwy
Fort
Lauderdale, FL 33308

# Empowering Parents with School Choice: Unleashing the Potential of Education
By Mark Robertson, Candidate for Nevada's First Congressional District
---
Peter,
Lesly and I have four children, two of whom are teachers and two of whom are married to teachers. Both Lesly and I were teachers, so we know the importance of education. The education system is crucial in preparing the next generation for success and innovation in today's rapidly evolving world. However, the one-size-fits-all approach to education fails to meet individual students' unique needs and preferences. Advocating for school choice is about empowering parents and recognizing that every child deserves the best possible education tailored to their specific requirements. By allowing parents the freedom to choose the educational institution that best suits their child, we can foster healthy competition, drive performance improvement, and ultimately elevate the quality of education for all. The Right to Choose As an advocate of school choice, I firmly believe that parents should have the right to decide about their child's education. Just as no two children are identical, no two schools are identical. Parents understand their children's personalities, learning styles, and aspirations better than anyone else. By granting them the right to choose, we acknowledge the vital role of parents as primary stakeholders in their children's education and respect their expertise in making the best choices for their future. Education Dollars Should Follow the Child In a fair and just society, education dollars should be directed to the school of the child's parent's choice. The current system often allocates funds based on a child's zip code, limiting their access to quality education. School choice empowers parents to direct funding to institutions that align with their child's unique needs, preferences, and academic goals. By doing so, we ensure that each child is afforded the same opportunity to succeed, regardless of their socio-economic background. The Power of Competition Competition is the driving force behind progress and improvement in any field, and education is no exception. When parents are granted the freedom to choose among various schools, a competitive environment is created, motivating educational institutions to continuously enhance their programs, curricula, and teaching methodologies to attract more students. School Choice Improves Performance Numerous studies have indicated that competition in education leads to improved performance across the board. Let's review some compelling statistics that shed light on the positive impact of school choice: 1. Academic Achievement: According to a study by the Friedman Foundation for Educational Choice, 31 out of 33 empirical studies found that school choice improves academic outcomes for participating students. They consistently outperformed traditional public school peers regarding test scores and graduation rates. 2. Parental Satisfaction: A report by the National Bureau of Economic Research revealed that parents who had the opportunity to choose their child's school reported higher levels of satisfaction and engagement in their child's education. 3. High School Graduation Rates: A study published by the Journal of School Choice found that students who attended private schools through voucher programs had significantly higher high school graduation rates than their peers in public schools. 4. Increased Efficiency: An analysis conducted by the CATO Institute reported that states with greater school choice programs tend to demonstrate increased efficiency in education spending, indicating that competition fosters resource optimization. Conclusion School choice is not about dismantling the public education system but rather about augmenting it with a diverse array of options that cater to the unique needs of individual students. Empowering parents with the freedom to choose the best educational setting for their children allows competition to thrive, raising the performance bar for all schools. As we advocate for school choice, let us envision a future where every child can access an education that nurtures their full potential, preparing them to become active contributors to society and driving positive change in the world. As your representative in Congress, I will fight for school choice! Decisions about a child's education should be made as close to that child as possible, preferably by the parents, not some bureaucrat in Washington, DC. *******
---
Your Questions--Mark's Answers
Mark Robertson answers your questions with direct and honest answers. Here are two questions Mark was asked recently:
Q: Is the United States' relationship with Israel important, and if so why? A: Yes! Israel is our strongest ally and the only democracy in the Middle East. We are connected in religion, culture, and politics. We share the same goals of peace through strength. We have a moral obligation to support Israel. It is in our self-interest to maintain a strong relationship with Israel. Q: What actions would you take that would allow Americans to retain more of their income and wealth? A: Reduce the size and reach of the federal government so that it stops consuming so much of our nation's wealth. Unleash our energy sector to bring down the cost of oil and gas, reduce inflation, and allow Americans to keep more of THEIR money.
Please share this message with friends and neighbors. Have questions for me? Simply reply to this email to ask me a question.

But with time running out until **Tuesday, November 5 th,** I’m counting on your help!

**[With so much at stake, can I count on you to please agree to your most generous contribution of $250, $100, $50, or even $25 to help _Students for Life Action_ pull this off](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-gtkmx-duchtdja-j/)?**

But Abby was changed forever when an abortionist asked her to hold an ultrasound probe against a mother’s abdomen while he committed an abortion.

As Abby watched in horror, ultrasound images showed the fully formed baby fighting for her life as her little body was ripped apart during the abortion.

At that moment, all _Planned Parenthood’s_ lies – _that abortion is women’s “healthcare” and preborn babies are just globs of flesh_ – went up in smoke for Abby.

**_Abby has since dedicated her life to abolishing abortion and exposing what the butchers at _Planned Parenthood_ are all about_.**

With the Abortion Lobby counting on the votes of young people to help them RAM through pro-abortion referendums and seize TOTAL control of Washington, D.C. in 2024, _young Americans need to see this movie now more than ever_.

That’s why _Students for Life Action_ is pulling out all the stops with our **Pro-Life Video Billboard Truck** to hit dozens of college campuses across the following states before November 5th:

| |

\- Arizona* | \- Colorado*
\- Florida* | \- North Carolina
\- Missouri* | \- Pennsylvania
\- Nebraska*

* Abortion ballot referendum states.

## **[>> Support _Students for Life Action's_ Abortion Extremism Mobile Billboard Tour <<](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-gtkmx-duchtdja-t/)**
At every screening, we expect to reach and convert hundreds of pro-abortion young people.

**But we won’t just screen the movie, pack up, and leave.**

We’ll also ensure every pro-lifer on these campuses is registered to vote, have them to join our campus group, promise to watch _Unplanned_ with at least one pro-abortion friend, and pledge to “Vote-Pro-Life First” in November.

Then, as Election Day nears, we’ll contact them again to follow through on their pledges.

Frankly, I believe this project could prove to be one of the most critical _Students for Life Action_ has ever conducted – _seeing as these young people will be the key to winning in 2024._

You see, young people are the demographic _Planned Parenthood_ depends on – _not just for their political power, but as customers for their bloody business as well._

In fact, nearly 90% of _Planned Parenthood_ facilities are located within walking distance of a college campus!

The good news is, through our work on college campuses, we’ve found we can turn 19% of on-the-fence/pro-abortion young people we talk to against abortion.

Those numbers have _Planned Parenthood_ scared stiff!

The Abortion Lobby knows that if they were to suddenly lose that much support with young people, the abortion empire would crumble overnight.

**_And as we’ve seen time and again, the movie _Unplanned_ has proven to be one of the most effective ways to turn young people against abortion_.**

As one (formerly!) “pro-choice” woman wrote in _Variety_ after seeing _Unplanned:_

_“I’ve heard alllll the arguments, and I’ve had alllll the logical rebuttals, but to actually SEE it? It just made [abortion] indefensible, and cut the legs out from under me . . . As a woman, I cannot ever again claim to be pro-woman and stand in favor of abortion. I’m out.”_

**_I’ve personally seen the tear-filled eyes of pro-abortion young people as they’ve watched this film and come out changed forever_.**

Now, with November right around the corner, I want you to help me inflict a blow on the Abortion Lobby that they’ll NEVER recover from.

## **[>> Support _Students for Life Action's_ Abortion Extremism Mobile Billboard Tour <<](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-gtkmx-duchtdja-i/)**
To drive down the costs of our _Unplanned_ screenings – _and ensure we can reach as many young people on as many Battleground State campuses as possible_ – we’ll be using our **Pro-Life Video Billboard Truck** to screen the movie.

You see, this truck is an incredible investment, as it ensures we can screen the movie outdoors, avoid the costs of renting rooms and equipment, and reach a wider audience as there won’t be a “cap” on how many students can attend based on how large a room is.

**Not only that, but we’re sure to attract A TON of curious young people who are just out walking around campus and want to see why there’s such a big crowd.**

Even _Planned Parenthood_ thinks they’re clever for copying us by sending a “mobile abortion mill” truck to the DNC in Chicago to commit abortions right outside the United Center.

But in reality, our **Pro-Life Video Billboard Truck** has attracted young people in droves on college campuses and received rave reviews by students, while the Abortion Goliath has caught MAJOR flak over their bloody cash grab at the DNC.

Even pro-abortion media outlets have had to cover the outrage over their attempt to copy our **Pro-Life Video Billboard Truck** – _which we expect to draw even more pro-lifers than years past!_

But that won’t happen if college administrators shut us down – or if their campus police do nothing to assist our security team when we’re targeted by pro-abortion radicals.

We’ve faced both problems in the past too . . .

**Which is why I’m really counting on you to help me pull off this massive** _Abortion Extremism Mobile Billboard Tour_**.**

**[So, will you please consider agreeing to your most generous contribution of $250, $100, $50, or even $25 to _Students for Life Action](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-gtkmx-duchtdja-d/)?**_

As I’ve stated, the movie _Unplanned_ just may be the most powerful weapon in the Pro-Life Movement’s arsenal right now.

And with all that’s on the line in 2024, _we can’t hold anything back_.

I hope you agree.

Thank you for everything you do for Life, Pro-Life Friend.

For Life,

Kristan Hawkins
President, _Students for Life Action_

P.S. – Believe it or not, the movie _Unplanned_ has become one of our very most effective tools in turning young people against abortion.

That’s why – _with November rapidly approaching – Students for Life Action_ is launching a massive **_Abortion Extremism Mobile Billboard Tour_** where we’re sending our **Pro-Life Video Billboard Truck** to screen _Unplanned_ on dozens of college campuses across eight hotly-contested states that WILL decide 2024.

## Israel, Hezbollah Exchange Heavy Fire
Israel and Hezbollah [exchanged heavy fire](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLFuwyAQQL_G3ojgwBAPDF2ypWtH64AjvoqAZaNEzddX6dzx6S1P7-u6XJEL19sn3sn33BaMnR-0nAVYAWYxY_KZCEiP5JUDY89SA4yrTzFEpUhpp9wUMUCwOeqUXdYyRUMje5Bg5BmsktJJfZonZeKs3UxaS6XNYCQl7m0_fTeufaVcftqD9lNs97H4tfftGPTHAJcBLrhVeh5v9Ya9cyw0wIWPHamIQgFrq-KGLxQbFjo6V8Z6iJVeoZWCq5hATla6KSGFOCNGa90kjc7WGD1jGHeftieXwod1g5G3O3L5a-n_n3l4-A0AAP__bcBlGg) Sunday morning, but both sides pulled back before the conflict escalated into an all-out war. It was the most intense fighting between the two in months.Hezbollah said their planned large-scale attack was [an initial response](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskD1vwyAUAH-NvRHBg_AxMHTJlq4drQc8YipiIkwdtb--SueOp1tO93Fdrlhq2W7veCc_clswjnLQYhloBmpRc_KZCEjO5IUBpS2XAPPqdeYiZ8g6hRR4BoegU4hgHVqMDufigYPiFrTg3HB5cmehopPGkZRcSDUpTqmM1k-frWxjpVy_20H9FNt9rn4d47FP8m2CywQXfGz03F_qBX2UWGmCS9k7UmWVAm5tYyv9hFYrrqx03NjXzpJECsKCjhEhhpiQC5eVMdYpQ-cwd58ez1Jr2bWZFL_dsdS_gvH_j8PDbwAAAP__fDth0A) to the killing of one of its founding members in Beirut last month. Israel says it struck Hezbollah military targets preemptively to thwart the attack. Meanwhile, the top U.S. general, C.Q. Brown, [arrived in the Middle East](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0DFzhCAUBOBfg91z8IGgBUUau0ub0uHkeZIgOIDn5N9nLlWKtLtbfLMft_lmffDx8W53MnVNs12qf9I8ACpAOcvGmZUISTRkOo1SDVwgNptxfTf2dhR6vd87JwWuXb9qLZRCZRfkjTfIUfIBVce55qId-04uo9AjCcE7IZnk5HxNuf1MPtaN1vCdnpTbJe1NMFutR2HijeHEcLquq810Vsrl1b-SlINjOO3euUBAtlSGU00HnAUeFCnbALv9ogJntDGmMy7k4M8cavYH-Gwj1C2TrRBS2gu83MAHQMlwarJxx-VD8EVpJvljtz78Euv_hz0N_gQAAP__bIxtWg) on an unannounced visit this weekend. He plans to attend the Israel-Hamas peace talks currently underway in Egypt.

## SpaceX to Conduct First Private Spacewalk
SpaceX mission Polaris Dawn is [set to make history](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsz7FuwyAQxvGnsTes4yCAB4Yu2dK1o0XNObmW2Agjk759Vc_dPuk3fPp_3KZb4MTr_T08yddlm8Jc-aDJCTQC9aT76BciJNWTlxa1caAQ-4e3btTgZNQQrXQKjfmExV7MhWR0aGzPHgE1ODQSwIIaxovU86jsSEqBVLrTQJHrVoavjdf6oCX9bAeVYd6effKPWvPeqbcOrx1eW2vDnsNMf9rh9dwvkbcUCu8ihraKXPgIlcRpLaRvQa-cAq9U-uJjbpwS78Z2Gu7PwOk8qv9nHx5_AwAA__8sjloO) as two crew members prepare for the first spacewalk ever conducted by a private, commercial mission.The [Dragon "Resilience"](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0D9vwyAUBPBPgzcieGD-DAxd2NK1o0XNI3kVMRZGSfvtq6RrtxtOv5Pu47ycE1XaLu_phmGUtqR10B0Xx8Fw0IueciiIgGrCIC1o44QCmK7B20_vtUhGSQmzN-gNmqKdmouT3vqJAgjQwoGRQlihTn6WevXKelRKSKWZFphptH76arSNK5b60-7YT2u7TTVcx9gPpt4YRAbx2NOK-L3X1jE_Gwzi02cQhXvmmUHcW02dDp7TY-MHDj4a75ix0Ib8JfA_Ig1qG4M49ZD3B9VKh7FMi8stUX3tj__fuAf4DQAA__-fLF9f) spacecraft launches Tuesday morning carrying four crew members. The spacewalk is planned for Thursday.The mission is being funded by one of its crew, [billionaire Jared Isaacman](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0L1upTAQQOGnMZ2RGXv5KVxsQ3e33RJNzPgyicHInoDu20dJnf4UR9__x_JATnw8_-FOXmJeMAhftIwaeg1ucc3qIxGQbch3A7h-NBag2TzGbgwUJ4Ox70I0NIwBiAjHtQsGhoY9GHBmhL4zZjC2nf50Lkx2mMha01mnnKGVJZf2PfMhG8X0yheVNuS9SX4TOauyfxXMCub7vtsamA7hyAF3Khzw-E4VzFiEQyIF85kTFq56xfvQXLVspPdcReP-xsL5s2o8Vl24frz0WfhCIV1PDBQTPzfRLxIFc1P8et6cEtd-UM48d-T08yW_K10evgIAAP__wcxtRw), in partnership with Elon Musk-owned SpaceX.One SpaceX official described the mission as "[a risky adventure](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLGypCAQRb8GMyxsUDEg2ITsbbqhxZNm7H0oFjI6_v2WM-lGfbvOCbrvn6_xy1Gk9fHbLWhKSKObCh04ag4dBzWqypuACCgrNE0PqtNCAlSzadX3oHoV2lZL8Kpz0kvlOwE6aBk6UZEBAUpo6BoheiHroW3UNMh-QClFIxVTAj2VlOu_idYyY4hXOjDXU1qqaOZStp3JXwwsA3ueZx1iyuRdSd5dt8TA7iXli4EtOM33OhGuE95pc-9538DACn3nloHNtP9cfEvRZdq5d-fK3-7p4g8vieNrSztyXAtl_KAX99k90nrjw03P58JT-CBOK0eXy8xT_qbCwPZK61aBEKJnYKts_HZSjLR3PVPisTiK7wfL_-s-DPwLAAD__y66gI4)," noting that all four crew members will rely solely on newly designed spacesuits for protection when they step out of the capsule.

## State Approves Record $104B for Highway Projects
The Texas Transportation Commission, which oversees TxDOT, approved a record $104.17 billion for a 10-year [highway maintenance and construction plan](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kLHOozAQhJ_GdIvMYgwULtJw1X_tlcixF1jF2AgcSN7-lPR_NSONNPr0_fsZfywHjvNfu5LJrymN1mU-aewANaAaVeHNXfq-KshULSrdqr7BYjHKE8q2q5zCuvdWNlZrR42ftOzu1UQFG5SoZIe6ko2usZx62XXWKS9brGnSQknynNNe5oUyvewxhXc6aS9dWotglpy3Q9Q3gYPA4bqucj3iZxM4UITnIXCIdH3i2xlUAwyVBLJugcAPCm-Y0g4Idw6BU4QtPA-40v4AjuDSynEGT856govzAnbb9nSShyPbTLAFGwUOdofbrdrmP---2I3frs_boVuh5LxaDl_g_Iu_0-D_AAAA__-zO3NZ), with major allocations for rebuilding I-45 and I-10 in Houston and widening I-35 in Austin. The [total spending plan](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx00LGOqzAQheGnMR1oGAw2hYvb0OW2WyLDjIklJ7bIxJt9-1XSb3OKrznS_3VZLz6meD_--xs7eYW8-l1i5dW2OLWoV92Q24DmvmHXG9ST0fOIzdUNtLH1-0wWeyA_k9msxrDv2gQMPDfRIaAGi1MP4zRgF2aw1u-awODAYVIamKLks5MrC7_8I6SfXPns9nxrkruKlIca_ilcFC5BSicvytIduSpcynNTuHxE4XKwtPFec6pMby5F4fKU94KBEXVLpw_SIuD4lNIVCs3pqHzHlOJjMkrDcfMxfa7ljxLV4W8AAAD__7GoYE8), including projects contingent on variable funding, amounts to $147.87 billion. Both figures are more than those approved last year. A TxDOT spokeswoman said the state's Unified Transportation Plan should accommodate the expanding economy and a population projected to [exceed 35 million](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx00LFuwyAQgOGnwRsRPgjGA0MXb-na0TrDOUHCxoKrk7x91e6d_-GXvq_bfMOU037_xI08v9YyY-B00uwkWAlmNl30i4pj35HvBzB2MOMVuodXIy6arDVXtOQGSwtgv2gFmkwYXeiSBwVGObC9uloNl3VUzmEwUQ2gabXCKIqJS73wg5he2Nb8LifVSyhbl_2D-WhCfwiYBExhafjdOO2_VcC007MJmHIJmAVM_IqFZaVM2KjJXsk3YZVHxl2upcpaMD7xLdN21HLSRju3rvp4PFPOqdlBGHXfMOW_Of9jcXr4CQAA__-ZOWNJ) by 2035, according to the Texas Demographic Center. The agency requested input on its plan last month and received [1,256 comments](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx00Ltu7CAUQNGvgW4QPsY8Corb0M1tU1oMjxkkbJA5cZy_jzJ92t0saX_c17svtezP_35LFq_cVh-wnGnVN5A3EKug0T54NBNNdlIgpBJmAfqyISgt5xQNiBgnn7UJWSyz4UHrh18ULRY4CK5BTnyRM7BsuNY-iMgVzClLIniKBdvB8JUwXX7k-t3OdLDQNlrtC7EPMv8j4Ai4jJ3hFRuyZzsJuP75IODehYALbdvKGKXtBNyvS8BxDUDAqVs_0kg7eixtZz1metjYv0qtZUhFBH9uvtQ3in88OC38BAAA___tsF3d), most of which concerned projects in the Permian Basin, such as the expansion of I-20 through Midland and Odessa.
## Lyft Driver Kidnapped, Forced to Drive to Miami
An Arlington Lyft driver was [kidnapped at gunpoint](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kDHPpCAQQH8NdhoYEaWguMZur73SjDCsk0MwStbdf3-57b_-5eXl_XksD-TE-fkbd3L1HcuCvvKLlqkF04JedBPcKoNVDTk1gjajtgM0m-utNDrKCH4d4rCSj6TjinYkFSczmYYdSNByAqPkYHroopXThF4HOUJP0QgtKXAtZ1c3qvTGK6ZPedHZ-bI3yW21HpfofwmYBcz3fXf758KMuZbM5T8kYM50XwLmVDwmATOelX0iAfNX2J4c6NrwpPYvh4zHwfnZKjsqK6Xqju1oTheOm1Piy4xCy-eOnL4B9YcfLwf_AgAA__-U1mQJ) by Miguel Alejandro Pastran Hernandez and spent 57 hours being forced to drive over 1,300 miles to Miami, Florida, according to federal prosecutors. Pastran Hernandez demanded that the rideshare driver maintain the speed limit during the journey and later ordered the driver to call home and say the driver was on a long work trip. Pastran Hernandez also allegedly took the driver's handgun and ammunition, which were stored separately in the vehicle. The driver escaped [by hiding in a store bathroom](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx00LGu3CAQheGnwR0rPGDABUUadzdtytUYht1RsLEwWd-8fbTbp_6lI33n19f9C7nw_viJG4X-nesdY-cX3b0EK8HczZDCqtI8DhRGB8Y6M08wPINZZ5OV8jiNk5uJbF49jN7ltCrS3gwcQIFRHuyoJqvhlmflPUaTlANN2QqjKHGv7daf1Okbz1z-1he1W6zbUMKz9-MU-oeARcByXdftyojvKGDB1jkWErDsdJ0Clth4o094e3rd5WdS_ua043Hw_pAb48Yyl9o4oWyc6HxiI5kav6jJXFukJB9_9qPy3gUs4J000Y8RdZR6nkZpvF6ln5WVAC5S0hZXp4cW0nFxKXxaJ4x6bMjlo-j_OfUV4F8AAAD__9kJeUc) in Florida, leading to Pastran Hernandez's arrest. Pastran Hernandez faces charges of kidnapping, carjacking, and firearm possession.
## Texas Promotes Eating Venomous, Tasty Lionfish
The Texas Parks and Wildlife Department is encouraging residents to eat invasive lionfish, even [sharing recipes](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0jz1vwyAUAH8N3mI9Pz4eDAxVK7ZUHSpltIiBBJWUyCA7_fdVune_0-lOx_noc8nfl3d_i7Y_Up390vMWZ31AdUAxiyHYMwQzDdFOhEKRMBKHq52UJqk9IRIFSCHoFDgoCqSE8JGGbBFQgEY1gVQcx2RAa7-IAIQ8JsUExJB7Xcd-jT0-fEvlp25xHZd6G4q99n5vjL8wdAzdvu9j8ks81_r1BBi6z4_T22v1rfvC0N1r642hMzBJNJIjTJIMf9rczWtYh9WG-55LyU0RE3C5-Vz-Wv2f9c3ibwAAAP__uB9Ygg), after one was caught consuming a native damselfish off the state's coast. These Indo-Pacific natives pose [a significant threat](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0z7GOhCAQxvGngU4zjIhSUFxjt9deaVgYdBKUjRJv7-0vt1dv--WXL_l_3eab58z78uk3cvWZyuxD5YvmsUHToJ61jO4O0SpJTg2ozaBtj3J18Q5dAjP2SUcYsAtRKa8wWiRlyVvJDgE1jGgU9KbDNlkYRx_-OSUjNFDkWo62rlTp6c-Uf8pFRxvKJrNba32covsQOAmcXiBz2ROfa1uO5W9bqTkD0x5I4CQPFx_fnDOfZhAals1zfn3VN2mXw98AAAD___s8UPs) to local Gulf of Mexico ecosystems, with no natural predators and the ability to produce millions of eggs annually. To combat the invasion, Texas is promoting lionfish consumption alongside broader efforts like the Flower Garden Banks National Marine Sanctuary's [Lionfish Invitational](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0z79ugzAQgPGnsbcgczbGHjx0yZauHdHhP-EkgyM4Qfr2Vbt3_r7l9_WYHkiVtucnrjnwu7QJI9OZJ3cDewMzGZnCrJLvZQ79CMaOxg8gl4Aa0lC0ttY755SdY4K-zAUjGI_9ICmAAqMc2F4NVkNXvHIOo0lqBJ2LFUblRNz2jpfM-Y1Hqd_tzHsX2yprWJhfh9AfAu4C7td1dZXaVuhYaDuJkaltWH9nAXe5h_S6qFY67CiMeq5If03yP64zwE8AAAD__zTLUJk), where trained divers remove lionfish. Officials stress that [proper handling techniques](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kLGO4yAURb8Gd1j4GWynoEjjZpWVttrSIvCwnwaDZUjI_P0o6ae6VzrN0fl_W26GAsX1r9lRl5dPi7GFnrhMHAYOcpGN03fhLl2DuhtBDqO8KGg2rUZUVipEATjZToCyvlfO9ajuznjRkAYBUkwwdEINPbT-IqbJWOnECD36gUmBjko627JhwZfJPnynJ56tTXsT9FbKkVl_ZTAzmGut7Z7jmzGYMfJHZjBHrO_5_HJUxzHa9DjNipmjKRRXHihFT3njxhc8eYrIq8ncp0d0PEdjvyiuDGZz8uu1O-jfn9ic2h2VQqA8jEyKdTcUPlbll0hPDT8BAAD__xB4a8c) must be used when catching and preparing lionfish to avoid the venomous spines, but once cleaned, the fish offers a tasty and eco-friendly seafood option.

To combat the invasion, Texas is promoting lionfish consumption alongside broader efforts like the Flower Garden Banks National Marine Sanctuary's , where trained divers remove lionfish. body:
I briefed President Trump on America’s most classified matters of national security while Director of CIA.

| |

---
| | | I endured the gauntlet of West Point Military Academy, then boot camp, then became a Tank Platoon Leader in the final days of the Cold War.

I briefed President Trump on America's most classified matters of national security while Director of CIA.

And I stood eye-to-eye with the most dangerous dictators in the world as Trump's Secretary of State.

**It takes a lot to make me feel on edge. So the fact that I 'm even sending you this email should give you pause. **

Because I'm afraid we have a problem. A big one.

I just got word that Kamala Harris and the Democrats are _closer than they 've ever been before_ to destroying our Conservative House Majority once and for all. The latest reports show they've stockpiled over $100,000,000 to defeat us in enough swing states to bring forth a COMPLETE LIBERAL TAKEOVER.

The ONLY THING standing in the way of Kamala Harris having full control - and ramming through any radical policy she wants - is just a few competitive House seats. That's it.

I don't tell you this lightly and I know that's not what you want to see happen to our country.

_**[That's why I'm rushing to you, in partnership with Majority Leader Steve Scalise, to raise a game-changing one million dollars in the next 72 hours.](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2z8qf9ugloiraiqds0gmi6njj68jqpgmr2jdh6vp8_rp22sh2s8i6eoj1cdge9o72cph2bs "That’s why I’m rushing to you, in partnership with Majority Leader Steve Scalise, to raise a game-changing one million dollars in the next 72 hours.")**_ I know what you're thinking... that's not enough runway to raise that much. But desperate times call for desperate measures. And if that's what it'll take to win, I'm willing to chase down every lead.

If all you can spare is ten or twenty bucks, that would be incredible. If you can afford more that's even better. I only ask that everyone give something.

Will you do what it takes to hand Kamala Harris and the Democrats a humiliating defeat?

But in my race for the United States Senate, I know exactly who is standing in our way. It’s a lot of pressure – but nothing I’m not used to. You see, Friend, I spent my years working for the once-trusted FBI. I know most Conservatives view the FBI as a broken institution – and for good reason. When I worked for the FBI, it was a great pillar of the American justice system. My team and I were focused on two things:
---
-Protecting innocent Americans.-Getting the bad guys.
---
THAT’S IT. But today, America’s justice system is a hollow shell of what it once was thanks to Joe Biden and Merrick Garland. Friend, at my heart I’m a Law Enforcement Officer and I know how valuable your time is. **[I’m running in the NUMBER ONE Senate race in America and I need your help – Chuck Schumer and co. are spending $40 million to defeat me.](http://links.rogersforsenate.com/u/click?_t=b90de78796ce4ce596523293a2b8ff82&_m=af223dd6e84e4a9399270a811878040e&_e=OYEXYyJtk-O18d3GtlNDI9hgUPKrcSQ0DfGQWI0TXvhUADvtuw6wL2bdUUFUcmqdS5h2-hd4NR5sPUTQoCWt4XVgUpOi98QXjbmuisqBg96Ti_j10UBPQRVldlh-eQcvNXaC9ONF_a0qDNMBknlRK47RBIMYfV4Rl-E9Wj6hVOwBv6yGmOttRXG0vpv2Pn_qcvxVk8z-RX_4F3maQ1MU3yhZKX1McOwa-JnbcqpQte-7g7oDa9mOkeJ52Oaozs_Asay5AjRlPgw7R0TqDTlvvZNh3VqO5GlaPU2bvmNyc9W0Ll_QUBYa_tlcSYu0_1EEKFkJ055lIAAL-jpGV69EVHKoLu-73bf4LRSVF1Goo6gFUlcegrqOfFaMVG_FPQODikTTs0LOH5l1q0ni2u43jFBLr0-q-3is6iRdk4Ybja6Mb6PlrubKlr_Yy4GdPICjgWcZXIbLgPUnzTMfj2NZ6dfE3q5SKbqydwlzSmYtHhQ%3D)** With the heart of a dedicated LEO – I’m humbly asking for your support today. **[Can you chip in a few bucks to help me take back Michigan’s U.S. Senate seat?](http://links.rogersforsenate.com/u/click?_t=b90de78796ce4ce596523293a2b8ff82&_m=af223dd6e84e4a9399270a811878040e&_e=OYEXYyJtk-O18d3GtlNDI9hgUPKrcSQ0DfGQWI0TXvhUADvtuw6wL2bdUUFUcmqdS5h2-hd4NR5sPUTQoCWt4XVgUpOi98QXjbmuisqBg96Ti_j10UBPQRVldlh-eQcvNXaC9ONF_a0qDNMBknlRK47RBIMYfV4Rl-E9Wj6hVOwBv6yGmOttRXG0vpv2Pn_qcvxVk8z-RX_4F3maQ1MU3yhZKX1McOwa-JnbcqpQte-7g7oDa9mOkeJ52Oaozs_Asay5AjRlPgw7R0TqDTlvvZNh3VqO5GlaPU2bvmNyc9W0Ll_QUBYa_tlcSYu0_1EEAKUzGZv-SOtXKPLp_KEBLk5MwHddlaJmlEKbJSyYSfE4RNlq3EP-ktjP4_UvyB7mxcbJchrO5AjsNb_8IwYNpANe1G1c2xbksUzfDj5OZXAMPkQ5iMbD9xp2RfiiEy3F5m5oSSCrlGElDCOOiy8UcKNfY0wIx8lWF0spqZx0OGQ%3D)** Friend, thank you for lending me your time and attention for just a moment – together we’re going to take our country back. body:
We get some big donations, and they’re certainly appreciated. But the most important people to this campaign aren’t just the folks writing those big checks.
#

Peter -
My team’s been reaching out quite a bit lately, as I’m sure you’ve noticed. But I hope you recognize that we’re not doing it to annoy the crap out of you, or to stress you out.
We’re doing it because you are one of the most important parts of this campaign.
**Here’s the truth:** Almost every single dollar we raise comes from a donation of $100 or less. Our average donation is around $32. We get some big donations, and they’re certainly appreciated. But the most important people to this campaign aren’t just the folks writing those big checks.
They’re people like you, Peter. People who were there when everything was on the line.
More than 300,000 people have made a donation to this campaign. It’s absolutely humbling, and I can’t begin to thank this team — and you — enough for it.
But we’ve got more to do if we’re going to win this thing.
Please, I’m humbly asking you:
[**Can you chip in a donation of $32 to my campaign? I’m sure you didn’t wake up this morning and decide to make a contribution, but to win in Arizona, that is what I am hoping you’ll do.**](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-august24.kZit_I&refcode=em240826-1-160&t=1&akid=2944%2E734936%2E_HFuCy)

Peter,

Today is Women’s Equality Day – a day to commemorate the passing of the 19th Amendment. This historic amendment outlawed voting discrimination based on sex and marked the first time some women were granted access to the ballot box.

The passing of the 19th Amendment was a huge step forward in the fight for equality. And yet, 104 years later, we find ourselves fighting for our bodies, voices, and futures.

Since the Supreme Court overturned _Roe v. Wade_ two years ago, we’ve seen unprecedented attacks on women’s right to choose. States across the country have passed restrictive abortion bans – including a six-week abortion ban in Iowa that just went into effect. These dangerous laws have left millions of women without access to the care they need.

But Christina’s opponent, Mariantte Miller-Meeks, and her GOP allies still aren’t satisfied. They want to pass legislation to further control women’s bodies and erase the progress women have made over the last century.

With just a short 10 weeks until Election Day, and women’s rights on the line, we must act now.

name: Rob Mercuri
subject: Mike Pompeo Endorses Rob Mercuri
body:
Former U.S. Sec of State Mike Pompeo is backing our campaign because he knows that we need peace through strength.

|
---
**Mike Pompeo Endorsement** With ongoing wars and tensions rising around the globe, it is important that the United States once again steps forward as a positive leader for peace and stability. That’s why I’m excited that our campaign was endorsed this week by former U.S. Secretary of State (and fellow West Point grad) Mike Pompeo. Secretary Pompeo understands the international challenges we face and he is endorsing [my approach of Peace Through Strength](https://robmercuri.nationbuilder.com/r?u=zSc54wteo7OLwvJb7HyJgo9QMpp_qOT3kbB0ot0qyQ7z0E8w23CbZ-L6f5nh099PivrVUCz79rQQ_VFR52TboB--j9iAN23NGHOAdOtJPvwJDSIfZnExp2EkfdTszBy7tq0W0r3g2u35Ho4S-923y7xwkwd8imi_JKQIjwaJG9jZhMo1EWT9LJzzf0bhbYF8&e=3e5e734082f1493d27255edb80fe3a63&utm_source=robmercuri&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=email_blast_08_25_24_to_suppor&n=1). As [I wrote in January](https://robmercuri.nationbuilder.com/r?u=zSc54wteo7OLwvJb7HyJgo9QMpp_qOT3kbB0ot0qyQ7z0E8w23CbZ-L6f5nh099PivrVUCz79rQQ_VFR52TboB--j9iAN23NGHOAdOtJPvwJDSIfZnExp2EkfdTszBy7tq0W0r3g2u35Ho4S-923y7xwkwd8imi_JKQIjwaJG9jZhMo1EWT9LJzzf0bhbYF8&e=3e5e734082f1493d27255edb80fe3a63&utm_source=robmercuri&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=email_blast_08_25_24_to_suppor&n=2), to restore international order and America’s primacy on the global stage, we must confront these existential and geopolitical threats head-on, with moral clarity and with the interests of American citizens front of mind. At West Point we learned first how to follow, next how to lead others and then how to fight and win as an integrated team. The long gray line of leaders continues to influence the world for good in the Army, overseas in forward deployed areas and across every sector of our economy and country as part of our call to fulfill a ‘lifetime of service to the nation.’ It's an honor to have the support of former Secretary of State, and fellow West Point grad, Mike Pompeo! Thank you for your endorsement! **3 Year Anniversary of Afghanistan Withdrawal** Today is the third anniversary of the Biden-Harris administration’s disastrous withdrawal from Afghanistan and the loss of 13 brave American service members who lost their lives during the botched withdrawal. We will never forget the 13 heroes who gave their lives for our country, and we honor their sacrifice and service. Three years later, the Biden-Harris regime has not been held accountable for their failures. Our country needs leaders who will honor the sacrifices made by our service members, and ensure those sacrifices are never in vain. We must learn from the past and lead with strength. **Chis Deluzio’s Record** As we approach the final ten weeks of the campaign, attention is beginning to focus on Congressman Deluzio’s record and the differences between our governing philosophies. Here are some recent votes where I would have cast my vote differently than he did:
* Chris Deluzio voted to let illegal immigrants vote in our elections. (SAVE Act)
* He voted against critical funding for our military and veterans because the bill prohibited sidetracking the VA to pay for free healthcare for illegal immigrants. (HR 8580)
* He voted to withhold defense services to Israel. (HR 8369)
* He voted against common-sense legislation to secure the border. (HR 2)

Chris Deluzio also endorsed Kamala Harris for President – the presidential nominee who said, “There’s no question I’m in favor of banning fracking.” Make no mistake, Deluzio will always put his partisan policies over the people of PA. I will work with both parties to strengthen our energy sector and work to find bipartisan solutions to the problems we face. In Congress, I will represent everyone in our region as part of a new generation of leaders and I will work to bring jobs back to Western PA and take common sense back to Washington. **Get Involved** [Join Team Mercuri](https://www.robmercuri.com/volunteer?e=3e5e734082f1493d27255edb80fe3a63&utm_source=robmercuri&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=email_blast_08_25_24_to_suppor&n=3) and let’s get our community and our country back on track! But if you have a minute, [**we’d like to explain exactly what we’ll do with your $3 contribution if you pitch in to the Democratic National Committee today.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-dnc-august-elect-dems-2024?amount=3&refcode=em_20240826_984_fr&refcode2=1044_22930333_Hqgxn2&akid=1044%2E22930333%2EHqgxn2) Here we go: With 70 days until Election Day, it’s clear the presidential race will come down to a few key battleground states such as Arizona, Georgia, Michigan, Nevada, North Carolina, Pennsylvania, and Wisconsin. [](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-dnc-august-elect-dems-2024?amount=3&refcode=em_20240826_984_fr&refcode2=1044_22930333_Hqgxn2&akid=1044%2E22930333%2EHqgxn2) You’ve probably heard that the DNC is investing millions of dollars into reaching voters in states like these. Strategic investments like these don’t just impact the presidential race. They have a powerful **multiplier effect** _(nested opportunities, as we like to call it)_ for Democrats down the ballot, too -- which is critical in our efforts to win the House and Senate and elect Democrats at _all_ levels of government. But of course, we aren’t just focused on swing states. In these final weeks, we have to reach as many voters as possible -- all over the country -- and make sure they have a plan to cast their ballots for Democrats. That’s why we’re strengthening our largest-ever voter protection program to protect against Trump and his allies’ attacks on our voting rights. It’s why we’ve made a six-figure investment in the Democrats Abroad program to register and earn the votes of the nearly 9 million Americans living and serving overseas. And it’s why we’re expanding our successful virtual organizing efforts to engage and mobilize as many volunteers as we can, so you can get involved no matter where you are. They have a powerful multiplier effect (nested opportunities, as we like to call it) for Democrats down the ballot, too -- which is critical in our efforts to win the House and Senate and elect Democrats at all levels of government. But of course, we aren’t just focused on swing states. In these final weeks, we have to reach as many voters as possible -- all over the country -- and make sure they have a plan to cast their ballots for Democrats. ---
Fellow Conservative,

As a former Navy SEAL and combat veteran, I’ve seen my fair share of battle. Between my and my wife’s service to our country, we’ve sacrificed years of our lives to make America a more safe and prosperous nation and to protect our God-given freedoms and liberties. We served so that our children and yours might grow up to realize their own American Dreams.

Duty to country. Service and sacrifice over self, **those are the traits that define me**. I’m proud of the work we did for our country. That said, the events of August 2021 rocked me to my core and ultimately led me to **[launch a campaign for the United States Senate last June.](http://links.justandfreegop.com/u/click?_t=8ca5ef3d31cc43bcb1fbe6968d953911&_m=e4d7104511664042a590bc8f6d16b11e&_e=gS8yWzbSVnlXVuwYT8vsHf9JpgnoaQ0H-6XAQgGs-6VI87L05VMZf7djt5nO-o7jnQPvEs29pw56B-tfDOM3qak7mTd1-WXFsAm_cu-4EfRJFll1rVvtEZtY0sEFtrp6uvkBMKEde-yn7Iwehnbz2L04Usq6j_Rqc9xLBpqrBLkrli9tYrxe6JcCSD87IRJah3sk0-mLp43VYuHGkhRqKbwLo5uQk8CHej7k8zVQAwuZPy9OGskanm3RnTFYa6_P8WsL2XXR_ud1xRi8AYrD16ccdshG_-eUmVKJSpKg2Z2lZZcA_LWDmo8f1lm5J6CouwZzF4Y-FHRNzYiB-utI_G5hvYOIJio4ZxJVWEIEEO0Nm1DV8uZpmB8mQGvrPrgdMkiA0JipqvQAtWMc32MJmcYqYmK-wIMYNtQz6CYzye8%3D)**

In August 2021, I was putting out wildfires in California by day as part of the aerial firefighting company that I run; by night, my colleagues [_**many veterans like me**_] and I were working the phones trying to get our friends and allies out of Afghanistan before the takeover by the Taliban. I remember vividly that at one point I was trying to help an ally **sneak through a tunnel to get him and his family to the airport** so that they could be evacuated on a U.S. military aircraft. The Taliban wanted these high-value targets dead; they wanted their families dead.

[](http://links.justandfreegop.com/u/click?_t=8ca5ef3d31cc43bcb1fbe6968d953911&_m=e4d7104511664042a590bc8f6d16b11e&_e=gS8yWzbSVnlXVuwYT8vsHf9JpgnoaQ0H-6XAQgGs-6VI87L05VMZf7djt5nO-o7jnQPvEs29pw56B-tfDOM3qak7mTd1-WXFsAm_cu-4EfRJFll1rVvtEZtY0sEFtrp6uvkBMKEde-yn7Iwehnbz2L04Usq6j_Rqc9xLBpqrBLkrli9tYrxe6JcCSD87IRJah3sk0-mLp43VYuHGkhRqKbwLo5uQk8CHej7k8zVQAwuZPy9OGskanm3RnTFYa6_P8WsL2XXR_ud1xRi8AYrD1365CfhVehW-KBjGm8hsq26OmFfIwWJ5DIdsTwbisceJmIz1wZu6pIqaFR4NF4Y-UEbnwE4LkeLwndFrPJim0MCi9USR5hsKn5_RBaa401oToUjf-AIUqcgiSOKX6cO60DdiDj24GEfwQ6iRpVUocwE%3D)
This continued for days. Throughout the entire process, _**“I kept thinking to myself, “The adult will come in the room and say, ‘Hey, this is a disaster; we’re going to stop this.’”**_

Every day it got worse.
Every day it was a disaster.
The adult in the room never materialized.

**Then, 13 Americans were vaporized at the gate to Kabul’s airport.** Billions of dollars in military and human assets were left behind – all so Joe Biden and Kamala Harris could get a press conference saying that he’d pulled the country out of an “endless war.”

I had sat in the homes of the families that we were frantically trying to get out; I had promised them that we weren’t going to leave them behind. _**So, you can imagine the dishonor that I felt**_ because of the promises we weren’t able to keep to the people who’d sacrificed so much to help us combat evil.

**If you're thinking this email is on the longer side, you're right.** If you're short on time and unable to finish reading to the end right now, **[please do me a quick favor and confirm that I have the correct information on file for you](http://links.justandfreegop.com/u/click?_t=8ca5ef3d31cc43bcb1fbe6968d953911&_m=e4d7104511664042a590bc8f6d16b11e&_e=gS8yWzbSVnlXVuwYT8vsHf9JpgnoaQ0H-6XAQgGs-6VI87L05VMZf7djt5nO-o7jR54HNctYSCJ0I9n30_KddLvSU1axb3Kqv93Ehz3eRLRnsP4hRdIHCETYdl21qOcT6XCS3vVGabBB6TkGxhusd-9dvFLmieCWw5-jiSCihCWkQX_OI5JVu8Nvcx8WbZraKpdfKcKWNUHZLFomuIOW6TIETxdvkzi58_ysKi_wPH7NaaS04sE-vAf7cNdIhsRGlXSZHMaJihnjtdrBbT0QJEqiNmKNm2-ajZp9E1GsySFp9q3kP832mTAYymPUt9DBGFP2RAuxV-JmJfJt_E_kR71AGTOJfFfe8LBRIcW7QTgA4_gqKfEfdvI4vjyNQIHV7HA63fZkfcWtB9-CwhxW60cJYeRS4WIm0yn9s_e7CkY%3D)** ; my opponent and his allies will not make winning this seat easy.

ENLIST WITH TIM TODAY->** ](http://links.justandfreegop.com/u/click?_t=8ca5ef3d31cc43bcb1fbe6968d953911&_m=e4d7104511664042a590bc8f6d16b11e&_e=gS8yWzbSVnlXVuwYT8vsHf9JpgnoaQ0H-6XAQgGs-6VI87L05VMZf7djt5nO-o7jnQPvEs29pw56B-tfDOM3qak7mTd1-WXFsAm_cu-4EfRJFll1rVvtEZtY0sEFtrp6uvkBMKEde-yn7Iwehnbz2L04Usq6j_Rqc9xLBpqrBLkrli9tYrxe6JcCSD87IRJah3sk0-mLp43VYuHGkhRqKbwLo5uQk8CHej7k8zVQAwuZPy9OGskanm3RnTFYa6_P8WsL2XXR_ud1xRi8AYrD1xn0wGdAOos--Q7UIvEH4BQ8yQW0KVDPGcJTO4D8n8aH6Vt935INWYc0Vq2K4a7haxyokasvK5Uy13PFO_RBHZ8GzsLWPDbCIaUO6aA2q9h5i8jhOqyrfe4Pfl7HrJGro_hfLiEvJcVscv8P8_KD-SQ%3D)

It was in the aftermath of the fall of Afghanistan that I ever truly considered entering politics. Deciding to launch a campaign for the United States Senate wasn’t an easy decision; **but the United States needs leaders who understand the sacrifice it’s taken to build our country. When your country calls and needs you, you have to answer. **

[](http://links.justandfreegop.com/u/click?_t=8ca5ef3d31cc43bcb1fbe6968d953911&_m=e4d7104511664042a590bc8f6d16b11e&_e=gS8yWzbSVnlXVuwYT8vsHf9JpgnoaQ0H-6XAQgGs-6VI87L05VMZf7djt5nO-o7jnQPvEs29pw56B-tfDOM3qak7mTd1-WXFsAm_cu-4EfRJFll1rVvtEZtY0sEFtrp6uvkBMKEde-yn7Iwehnbz2L04Usq6j_Rqc9xLBpqrBLkrli9tYrxe6JcCSD87IRJah3sk0-mLp43VYuHGkhRqKbwLo5uQk8CHej7k8zVQAwuZPy9OGskanm3RnTFYa6_P8WsL2XXR_ud1xRi8AYrD1xuscVQ5SVj_qCy77TUSxTc4PO7DXVCxZMQXTSCh1QBzrMJVc8DVa5E5V_ya2ZZjXafIAgeehZaT4PsSfCLWzn5_zHASqdowxEZsV5AB8oIK57V47qOvSIgC6wm7ZLgitnB0jvTjGnw8XSTUtbSKzmE%3D)
**Unlike Joe Biden and Kamala Harris, I understand what it is to serve our country. Not service in politics, but on the battlefield.** I’ve been wounded in service of our nation; I’ve lost mentors and friends who were willing to make the ultimate sacrifice so that future generations will be free. [**ENLIST WITH TIM
CONFIRM YOUR SUPPORT TODAY->** ](http://links.justandfreegop.com/u/click?_t=8ca5ef3d31cc43bcb1fbe6968d953911&_m=e4d7104511664042a590bc8f6d16b11e&_e=gS8yWzbSVnlXVuwYT8vsHf9JpgnoaQ0H-6XAQgGs-6VI87L05VMZf7djt5nO-o7jnQPvEs29pw56B-tfDOM3qak7mTd1-WXFsAm_cu-4EfRJFll1rVvtEZtY0sEFtrp6uvkBMKEde-yn7Iwehnbz2L04Usq6j_Rqc9xLBpqrBLkrli9tYrxe6JcCSD87IRJah3sk0-mLp43VYuHGkhRqKbwLo5uQk8CHej7k8zVQAwuZPy9OGskanm3RnTFYa6_P8WsL2XXR_ud1xRi8AYrD13ia5t5uEl06sG2ZRPiy1dXIGzlToZxDS_nEJdaFBHNsuhRtR5-BZqjCOxDpuPGalfZMw9FcU2podRTV1IhOFgaAT9DRYnc9GMVt7NhexqjxyOx2R10QrFRPe0DOvLu9z_bj0GPIhLgLlJUV9Zb1ug0%3D)

I’m reaching out to you today because if this campaign to flip Montana’s U.S. Senate seat is going to be successful, **[I’m going to need the help of every conservative donor who reads this letter.](http://links.justandfreegop.com/u/click?_t=8ca5ef3d31cc43bcb1fbe6968d953911&_m=e4d7104511664042a590bc8f6d16b11e&_e=gS8yWzbSVnlXVuwYT8vsHf9JpgnoaQ0H-6XAQgGs-6VI87L05VMZf7djt5nO-o7jnQPvEs29pw56B-tfDOM3qak7mTd1-WXFsAm_cu-4EfRJFll1rVvtEZtY0sEFtrp6uvkBMKEde-yn7Iwehnbz2L04Usq6j_Rqc9xLBpqrBLkrli9tYrxe6JcCSD87IRJah3sk0-mLp43VYuHGkhRqKbwLo5uQk8CHej7k8zVQAwuZPy9OGskanm3RnTFYa6_P8WsL2XXR_ud1xRi8AYrD1_NvyFEc2oC6yPOFy7XzESFIvTKc2p8Hqch4jHyHWstOSlmmHyvPSCfz1KghAcWx1M4Fkj47LF3IXBFu2dxeJcSDpqtplave8Dr_4IPVhDn4qAV-L39D74LwLIL7u8txgiRvybCf9qjbMoUCRPCR4YY%3D) **

Twice in a row, Joe Biden has pulled us out of two wars for political purposes.

We fought in Iraq, _**I was there.**_ We fought in Afghanistan, _**I was there.**_

And each time, for political purposes, Biden pulled out our forces and damaged our nation’s reputation in the process. And my opponent in the Senate race, Democrat Jon Tester, supported Biden both times.

I want to look at my children and tell them, _**“Yes, you should serve your country, as your mom and dad did. Your parents put on the uniform; you should do the same.”**_

[](http://links.justandfreegop.com/u/click?_t=8ca5ef3d31cc43bcb1fbe6968d953911&_m=e4d7104511664042a590bc8f6d16b11e&_e=gS8yWzbSVnlXVuwYT8vsHf9JpgnoaQ0H-6XAQgGs-6VI87L05VMZf7djt5nO-o7jnQPvEs29pw56B-tfDOM3qak7mTd1-WXFsAm_cu-4EfRJFll1rVvtEZtY0sEFtrp6uvkBMKEde-yn7Iwehnbz2L04Usq6j_Rqc9xLBpqrBLkrli9tYrxe6JcCSD87IRJah3sk0-mLp43VYuHGkhRqKbwLo5uQk8CHej7k8zVQAwuZPy9OGskanm3RnTFYa6_P8WsL2XXR_ud1xRi8AYrD15ZUVRTaS4kML0KGQw7-HhJvjT4RfjXNIHCwb6uh09i5E-34xOslaHqS-PHWfXxKh2aPWW1uynJ719a71xU7wgWPi7bNuU7hYCcS45ze1I3NaYRF0OODvZelDusURBGyKCb2amzCuVq5icCA-oVdkCA%3D)
**But when we have a president who is willing to pull the plug on a whim for political purposes, it’s hard to tell future generations the sacrifices in service of God and country will be worth it.**

So, Fellow Conservative \- that’s what I’m fighting for. I’m fighting to restore faith in our American way of life. I entered the political arena to ensure the sacrifices my friends made weren’t made in vain.

Between my and my wife’s service to our country, we’ve sacrificed years of our lives to make America a more safe and prosperous nation and to protect our God-given freedoms and liberties. We served so that our children and yours might grow up to realize their own American Dreams. Duty to country. Service and sacrifice over self, those are the traits that define me. I’m proud of the work we did for our country. That said, the events of August 2021 rocked me to my core and ultimately led me to In August 2021, I was putting out wildfires in California by day as part of the aerial firefighting company that I run; by night, my colleagues [many veterans like me] and I were working the phones trying to get our friends and allies out of Afghanistan before the takeover by the Taliban. I remember vividly that at one point I was trying to help an ally sneak through a tunnel to get him and his family to the airport so that they could be evacuated on a U.S. military aircraft. The Taliban wanted these high-value targets dead; they wanted their families dead. This continued for days. Throughout the entire process, “I kept thinking to myself, “The adult will come in the room and say, ‘Hey, this is a disaster; we’re going to stop this.’” Every day it got worse. Every day it was a disaster. The adult in the room never materialized. Then, 13 Americans were vaporized at the gate to Kabul’s airport. Billions of dollars in military and human assets were left behind – all so Joe Biden and Kamala Harris could get a press conference saying that he’d pulled the country out of an “endless war.” I had sat in the homes of the families that we were frantically trying to get out; I had promised them that we weren’t going to leave them behind. Today is National Women's Equality Day, a day that commemorates 104 years of women having the right to vote.
Last week, I became the first Latina nominee for Senate from Florida. As I reflect on the progress women have made in the U.S. since 1920, I keep coming back to this line from the majority decision to overturn Roe v. Wade _,_ justifying why the right to abortion should be left to the states:
_"Our decision returns the issue of abortion to those legislative bodies, and it allows women on both sides of the abortion issue to seek to affect the legislative process by influencing public opinion, lobbying legislators, voting, and running for office.**Women are not without electoral or political power.**"_

— Justice Samuel Alito
What Alito doesn't mention is that women make up less than 30% of the House of Representatives and only _a quarter_ of U.S. senators.
He fails to consider how women are less likely to run for office and how, when they do, women are more likely to face negative attacks and have a harder time fundraising. And even once they're in office, bills introduced in Congress concerning "women's issues" are twice as likely to end in deadlock.

Here's the real truth, friend: **Women are systematically excluded from political power, and excluded from equal representation**.
The overturning of Roe v. Wade and rolling back of reproductive rights in Florida and beyond proves that, **since the majority of Americans disapprove of the Supreme Court’s decision to overturn Roe v. Wade.**

**That's why I'm running to defeat Rick Scott, who proudly backed DeSantis' abortion ban, co-sponsored the bill to enact a nationwide ban on abortions, and voted against both IVF and birth control protections.**

Hey team —
There’s a little over a year to go until _GTA VI_ , but that’s not the big story here.
While video game corporations have been hard at work maximizing profits at the expense of workers’ pay and wellbeing, **unions have been clapping back.**
Most recently, Blizzard Entertainment’s 500 employees unionized — that’s the team behind _World of Warcraft_!
Conversely, video game performers, the people behind the voices of your favorite characters and finishing moves, are going on strike to protect themselves and their art from AI. Valid AF.

| Friend,
Let me tell you why I'm working so hard to get Jerry Evans elected to Congress: Jerry doesn't care about being politically correct. He isn't afraid to stand up and call out something that isn't' right. Did you see the article in the Kane County Reporter? Jerry was quoted denouncing the antisemitism and violence we saw in our own community last week. What did Bill Foster say? Nothing. Here is an excerpt from the article:
---
| "It's heartbreaking to see protesters openly supporting violence and chanting hate in our backyard," Evans told Chicago City Wire. "However, I believe that most of these agitators are being brought into Chicago from elsewhere; the citizens of Illinois are kind and open-minded people who do not harbor any antisemitic beliefs."
Evans expressed his disappointment with President Biden's acknowledgment of the protesters during his DNC speech by saying, Those protesters out in the street, they have a point.
"It does not matter what your political ideology is; every decent person should denounce all forms of violence and intimidation," said Evans.
Evans is also urging his opponent, Democratic Congressman Bill Foster, to take a stand. "My opponent, Bill Foster, has yet to denounce the violent protesters and stand by our Jewish community here in Illinois," Evans said. "I call on him to immediately condemn the violent agitators who are destroying downtown Chicago."
Evans also called for legal consequences for those involved in the protests. "Anyone who breaks the law, including what we are seeing this week in downtown Chicago, should be prosecuted to the full extent of the law," he said. "Unfortunately, the media refuses to cover the violence and disgusting behavior of the violent protestors outside the DNC Convention."

Photo by [Marek Studzinski](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/8c99c5d1-7af9-42bd-8772-eb4469c8eef9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) on [Unsplash](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/7e727584-190b-4f76-970b-f7eea3343d96?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
This Green New Deal of Connecticut and this nation has been all about paying for your neighbor to put in Solar Panels. This is a subsidy for an inefficient and uneconomical form of electricity for us in Connecticut. **As I have been saying - micro nuclear and expansion of natural gas are my Federal Energy Policies for my campaign.**
Thanks for reading Michael's Substack! Subscribe for free to receive new posts and support my work.
[Pledge your support](https://substack..jxyLOl1v1HyUyVF6SB9PHKpFEIqM-Gn6mtY8iwQtqnk?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget-preamble&utm_content=148147356)
If solar is so great - [SunPower](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/b93c611f-4700-4da9-b340-a8c5691234db?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), one of the country's top rooftop solar installers, recently declared bankruptcy and many others are struggling like Titan Solar Power and [Sunworks](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/1a710d93-2685-4492-a176-dc0df0541e6b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
[DONATE](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/c944db5c-dfab-4c2c-a5a5-8cdf7a26f8af?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
A recent editorial in the Wall Street Journal entitled : "**Another Green Energy Subsidy Bust SunPower files for bankruptcy, thanks in part to Biden 's tariffs ([see article](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/b8b14e92-8116-4a3c-8b32-b82f9253e3c9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg))**
Our economy is powered and grew on gas and diesel engines. Good paying American jobs were created and supported through the production and use of gas and diesel and magically, small business owners of gas stations profited and created jobs.
Gas stations are not a business in need of a subsidy and state and federal taxes are also generated for every gallon of gas sold. So it's a win-win until the EV charging stations which are a lose-lose.
In addition to wasting your time while you wait to charge your EV, these EV self-operated stations are losers and unprofitable to build. _**It is simple, where there is a subsidy, its either a necessity or a loser**_.
Where gas stations raise tax revenue, EV stations spend tax payer money. Most charging stations are self-operated and almost no labor is required. No land is needed like a gas station for tanks and infrastructure. You can just install one in a parking space. Yet these subsidized companies are going bankrupt.
_So why is it that an EV charging station which pays no state and federal highway taxes, does not require labor to deliver and sell the energy, does not require the labor and trucking costs to deliver the energy so unprofitable that it needs to be subsidized?_
We have been paying taxes for far to long to subsidize green energy policies.
They keep forgetting the Deal part of the Green New Deal - **there is no Deal to be had. Where are all the Green New Deal jobs from the Inflation Reduction Act?**
It is time for us to stop subsidizing failing green energy ventures, with taxpayer money, that are not economically viable. That includes the offshore wind projects that are here in Connecticut.
Green energy like any other business needs to become competitive to succeed.
Say no to the subsidies for EV charging stations.
It is time for the taxpayers to stop subsidizing unprofitable businesses through taxes and higher utility rates.
We have enough pain at the pump thanks to Mr. Jim Himes and the Biden/Harris Administration. This election is a referendum and a restoration of common sense economics that you pay for what you use and you stop paying for your neighbor's bad choices.
Any support is appreciated as we have a race to win, a State to take back and a Country to Heal. **Together we can get it done. Not looking for a subsidy but to return your investment in me with sensible leadership.**

Here at Youth Vote HQ, we’re not going to “beg” you to help us make a difference. We’re not going to tell you that we’re “on our hands and knees” waiting for your support. And we’re definitely not going to fill your inbox with spam just to get our point across. Instead, we’re going to respect you enough to tell you the truth. And the truth is, as much as he tries to deny it, Donald Trump will implement Project 2025 if he wins this election. He’ll start off any potential second term like a dictator and completely undermine our rights and democracy. Young voters everywhere are determined to make sure that doesn’t happen. We’re working our hardest to meet the next generation of voters where they are and encourage them to make a difference at the polls. During the COVID-19 era, many politicians, especially Democrats, promoted the idea that our society should be led by "experts." These individuals exhibited little faith in the average American citizen, suggesting that we are incapable of making our own decisions. Despite our apprehensions about taking an untested and unproven vaccine, we were told to comply and follow our leaders.
Over time, we have seen the "experts" proven wrong. Once again, the average citizen, armed with a healthy dose of skepticism, demonstrated better judgment than politicians and experts.
This elitist attitude has also infiltrated our educational system. Parents are urged to defer to the so-called "experts" when it comes to educating their children. However, history and results favor the average parent. Parents inherently know what is best for their children and make better decisions regarding their education.
This is why the Republican Party has adopted a platform supporting "School Choice." The 2024 Republican Party Platform includes a clear endorsement of universal school choice:
> "Republicans believe families should be empowered to choose the best education for their children. We support Universal School Choice in every State in America."
The Mississippi Republican Party's Platform states:
> "Parental involvement in education should extend to allowing parents to choose the school that best meets the educational needs of their children."
Parents, not government experts, are better equipped to make decisions for their children.
Giving parents a choice in their child's education has led to increased graduation rates, improved future financial well-being, crime reduction, and higher parent satisfaction across the United States.
School choice allows parents to take a more active role in their child's education, choosing a school that best fits their child's needs. Since the pandemic, parents have become more motivated to push for education reform and for the expansion of opportunities for their children.
Mississippi has struggled to advance the rights of parents to choose the best education for their children, largely due to the power of public school lobbying groups within our state. These organizations have convinced legislators to prioritize the interests of the public school establishment over the wishes of parents and the needs of children. As a legislator, I have personally heard leaders of these organizations express indifference to some children being left behind, as long as they remained in "public" schools.
However, Donald Trump is leading a renewed dedication to our Republican Platform and ideology within our party, striving to return power to parents.
Mississippi Republicans have an opportunity to improve our educational system by putting parents in control. Experts are not the answer--parents are the key to better education for all children.

| Massachusetts Students Face Educational Crisis as Resources are Diverted to Support Migrant Influx
---
---
|
Boston, MA- As the 2024-2025 school year approaches, parents across the Commonwealth are grappling with the harsh reality that their children's education may be at risk. With school budgets being reallocated to support migrant students across Massachusetts, many parents are growing anxious as their children face reduced instructional time and fewer resources. The diversion of funds has left teachers with pink slips and students with a less promising future. School districts are making difficult decisions: cutting bus services, increasing student-athlete fees, canceling advanced classes, and eliminating art programs.
It doesn't take long to see that towns like Stoughton, which are housing migrant families, are at the heart of the issue. In the past year, Stoughton raised its budget by 7% to meet rising costs, while also being directed by the Healey-Driscoll Administration to house 237 migrant families. However, this 7% increase does little to address the additional expenses, including accommodating 162 new students who now require bus services. Despite this, the school district was forced to eliminate one of its existing buses. According to state law, migrant students must be provided with transportation, even as 150 existing students are left without bus services. Beyond transportation, English language and mental health services are being overwhelmed, not just in Stoughton, but also in towns like Hanover and Brookline.
MassGOP Chair, Amy Carnevale, provided comment on the migrant crisis's impact on students' education stating, "The migrant crisis is affecting every facet of life for Massachusetts residents, and now it has reached our most vulnerable population--our children. Students are being deprived of opportunities to reach their full potential as advanced placement classes are cut. Parents are being forced to stretch their budgets to support their children's passions in sports and the arts. Bus services, once a fundamental resource for working families in Massachusetts, are being taken away."
"When will this stop? With no end in sight, this crisis is only set to worsen. The Healey-Driscoll Administration and the Democratic supermajority must take decisive action to address the migrant crisis and restore the Massachusetts education system--the pride of our Commonwealth--to its former glory before it's too late," Carnevale concluded.

| |

| | | I endured the gauntlet of West Point Military Academy, then boot camp, then became a Tank Platoon Leader in the final days of the Cold War.

I briefed President Trump on America's most classified matters of national security while Director of CIA.

And I stood eye-to-eye with the most dangerous dictators in the world as Trump's Secretary of State.

**It takes a lot to make me feel on edge. So the fact that I 'm even sending you this email should give you pause. **

Because I'm afraid we have a problem. A big one.

I just got word that Kamala Harris and the Democrats are _closer than they 've ever been before_ to destroying our Conservative House Majority once and for all. The latest reports show they've stockpiled over $100,000,000 to defeat us in enough swing states to bring forth a COMPLETE LIBERAL TAKEOVER.

The ONLY THING standing in the way of Kamala Harris having full control - and ramming through any radical policy she wants - is just a few competitive House seats. That's it.

I don't tell you this lightly and I know that's not what you want to see happen to our country.

_**[That's why I'm rushing to you, in partnership with Majority Leader Steve Scalise, to raise a game-changing one million dollars in the next 72 hours.](https://email.alerts.therepublicanteam.com/c/eJyUkTGL3DAQhX-N3MlII0uyCxcHh7sLIRykFGN78ApkrZHHe_fzgzYkTZpcPe_Nm_fNz7fwhjHFvH3DnUYuHMoZ-BHOBZOkvF6FVsk3CqCgk6qX4IJp1rHzsBrX0Kg9dG4wzqvmNg4zIc5dT95hN6AetLXGqnmGQWmn-yaOdY_qwWmnhs62q0fbK6TFOU8KvOgUJip8tnyjQsc1p7hgZsK9Xe57k8Yb83EK8yJgEjCdtFyF2o-YC61VIWCqYlkLxJMETMd9P-j-t8yGV-ZEXP1mKtVfYt6EeeVykQB38R4W3A-MWxbm9ffBegjfX-T7j3fdam08QGBtDVhvpfbWCXD0GTiuXzA8c-6ZKXMNf0guLP_gEeA-r_z4d9CUcT0-YkrxdJXWtmNMTzT83-97jPArAAD__2t2mtM "That’s why I’m rushing to you, in partnership with Majority Leader Steve Scalise, to raise a game-changing one million dollars in the next 72 hours.")**_ I know what you're thinking... that's not enough runway to raise that much. If all you can spare is ten or twenty bucks, that would be incredible. If you can afford more that's even better. I only ask that everyone give something.

Will you do what it takes to hand Kamala Harris and the Democrats a humiliating defeat?

## **Meteorological/Climatological**
Tropical cyclones Hector, Hone and Gilma**** bring will serve a triple punch to **Hawaii** this week. Tropical storm [Hone](https://substack.com/redirect/38e96e90-ea50-48e4-b4a4-02cdd236dc10?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) crossed over the Hawaiian islands Sunday, and Glima and Hector will bring more wind and surf as they approach the islands Friday ([Gilma](https://substack.com/redirect/bad10e76-e30b-46ce-b71d-434019964a87?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)) and Sunday/Monday of next week ([Hector](https://substack.com/redirect/f97104e7-5412-409d-8cd3-843574d2aa63?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)).
In the Western Pacific, Typhoon Shanshan has reached wind speeds nearing Category 3 strength and is expected to continue intensifying as it approaches**Japan** in the next few days. Models show an estimated 960 mbar minimum pressure as Shanshan reaches Japan at the 72 hours mark from the most recent model runs (6:00 am today, August 26, 2024). While minimum pressure is not a 1:1 direct correlation to wind speed, storms with 960 mbar pressure usually bring Category 3 hurricane strength.
A dam collapse in northeast Sudan[ killed 60 people](https://substack.com/redirect/11621d26-7ea2-4f88-b4db-a78d5a95effe?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Saturday night. Heavy seasonal rainfall is suspected to be the cause.
Much of the Midwest is experiencing [extreme heat](https://substack.com/redirect/184cc027-bdc7-4a48-8152-36102d5af4ca?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) this week, with extreme temperatures expected across the Northeast in the coming days. Temperatures on the East Coast may reach above 100 degrees F this week, shattering heat records for the end of August/early September.
## **Geological**
Last week's report from the Smithsonian Institution's Global Volcanism Program showed 45 volcanoes in continuing eruption status. No new eruptions have been reported this week.
The USGS recorded two earthquakes of magnitude six or higher this week, both of which occurred off the eastern coast of Fiji on Sunday, August 25.
