The World Health Organizations [reports](https://substack.com/redirect/85e85447-425a-4bfd-b200-86a4f6fb7806?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) that 713 Americans died of COVID-19 in the past seven days. The CDC failed to update its information as scheduled on Friday, and is still reflecting data from [before August 17, 2024](https://substack.com/redirect/2787b500-38de-492e-942a-fd7f22738c18?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). At that time, positivity was at 18% and ER visits, hospitalizations and deaths were all experiencing significant increases. Nearly 2,200 Americans have died of COVID-19 so far this month.

# **International Conflict**
##### **Afghanistan:**
Taliban Bars UN Human Rights Monitor From Entering Afghanistan. A Taliban spokesperson blamed Richard Bennett for "spreading propaganda;" he was appointed in April 2022 and had been tasked with documenting human rights violations in the country [(TOLONews)](https://substack.com/redirect/a72adf45-2fc4-444f-a333-e6e1b693b2cd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). The UN Human Rights Council did not immediately comment; Bennett could not be reached [(Reuters)](https://substack.com/redirect/dbf4988f-f58c-4686-913c-4946ee4bd977?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). The news comes as the Taliban continues to target women with oppressive laws, including a law that[ bans women from reading or singing in public](https://substack.com/redirect/68b4656a-daf4-4eb2-a614-ca171cce80e2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), and a permanent ban on girls attending school beyond sixth grade.
##### Haiti
Washington Sanctions Former Haitian President, Citing Role in Drug Trade. ##### The Sahel
Burkina Faso, Mali, Niger Accuse Ukraine of Supporting Rebel Groups in the Sahel Region. Ukraine has repeatedly called the accusations by the three military-led countries groundless; Russian paramilitaries are allied with Mali's junta and were among those targeted by rebels last month [(Reuters)](https://substack.com/redirect/9c2ad7f3-8aba-4ab5-a9e0-f813a7a34130?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
##### **Sudan**
Sudan's Government Opens Border Crossing for Aid, Says It Will Participate in Talks. The army-aligned government said it will send a delegation to Cairo for talks on a humanitarian deal after staying away from meetings in Switzerland that began last week on a cease-fire [(AFP)](https://substack.com/redirect/dd2ccfa3-2e1c-43a0-9447-808aaacccafe?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). On Saturday, UN Secretary-General Antonio Guterres welcomed the government's reopening of the Adre border crossing with Chad last week; the crossing is a central aid route for the Darfur region that had been down since February [(UN News)](https://substack.com/redirect/5ca228ee-84ad-447f-9c9d-3dfc77562c07?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).Fifteen aid trucks have entered Sudan from Chad after the Sudanese army temporarily reopened a border crossing last week that it had closed in February, a UN official said; at least 116 aid trucks still remain at the border, according to the United Nations [(Reuters)](https://substack.com/redirect/21cde681-2171-4610-a794-5d45f8c73115?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). More than six million people face food insecurity across the Darfur region [(Reuters)](https://substack.com/redirect/690fb677-e08c-40a3-8468-3061d3569034?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).

##### **Ukraine: **

##### **Venezuela**

| | | I endured the gauntlet of West Point Military Academy, then boot camp, then became a Tank Platoon Leader in the final days of the Cold War.

I briefed President Trump on America's most classified matters of national security while Director of CIA.

And I stood eye-to-eye with the most dangerous dictators in the world as Trump's Secretary of State.

**It takes a lot to make me feel on edge. So the fact that I 'm even sending you this email should give you pause. **

Because I'm afraid we have a problem. A big one.

I just got word that Kamala Harris and the Democrats are _closer than they 've ever been before_ to destroying our Conservative House Majority once and for all. The latest reports show they've stockpiled over $100,000,000 to defeat us in enough swing states to bring forth a COMPLETE LIBERAL TAKEOVER.

The ONLY THING standing in the way of Kamala Harris having full control - and ramming through any radical policy she wants - is just a few competitive House seats. That's it.

I don't tell you this lightly and I know that's not what you want to see happen to our country.

_**[That's why I'm rushing to you, in partnership with Majority Leader Steve Scalise, to raise a game-changing one million dollars in the next 72 hours.](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/8PhjxmespF9G-VbAJWZybw~~/AARclAA~ "That’s why I’m rushing to you, in partnership with Majority Leader Steve Scalise, to raise a game-changing one million dollars in the next 72 hours.")**_ I know what you're thinking... that's not enough runway to raise that much. But desperate times call for desperate measures. And if that's what it'll take to win, I'm willing to chase down every lead.

If all you can spare is ten or twenty bucks, that would be incredible. If you can afford more that's even better. I only ask that everyone give something.

Will you do what it takes to hand Kamala Harris and the Democrats a humiliating defeat?

Friends - If you were waiting for the perfect time to make one more donation to my campaign for Senate, not only is today the perfect day but there's also a very good reason as well. Betsy DeVos. If you're already familiar with her significant support for my opponent and are ready to chip in to my campaign and Serve America, please use this link to give: [**secure.actblue.com/donate/serve-slotkin**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/91553030/494210715/1036952885?refcode=240826&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjUvMS83NDc1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiNTc2MWIzMS1jNjYzLWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkYmZjNGIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=HbETP-u1wxt_jjj3Z5kngpkgxwOvajHHRzppbWir3E0=) Otherwise, let me go a little deeper ... including a very recent revelation about her designs on a role in a second Trump administration. As Michiganders know, for decades the DeVos family’s #1 issue has been weakening Michigan's, and the country's, public education system. Betsy DeVos used Michigan as her petri dish before becoming Trump’s Secretary of Education, and one of his longest serving cabinet secretaries. Much like our Republican opponent, Mike Rogers, she condemned Donald Trump after January 6, 2021. In Betsy DeVos’ case, she “resigned in protest” as Education Secretary, blaming his rhetoric on the insurrection — just 13 days before the end of Trump’s term. And like my current opponent who turned around and worked hard for Trump's endorsement, Betsy DeVos is now back — and willing to serve in a second Trump administration. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/91553034/494210717/1036952885?refcode=240826&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjUvMS83NDc1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiNTc2MWIzMS1jNjYzLWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkYmZjNGIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=HbETP-u1wxt_jjj3Z5kngpkgxwOvajHHRzppbWir3E0=) So what does that mean? As if there weren't already a million reasons to defeat Donald Trump, there's now one more: keeping Betsy DeVos out of any role of prominence in Washington, D.C. And there is no doing that without winning in Michigan. The DeVos family has been some of the top supporters to opponents of mine in the past, and they've doubled down on this Senate race. Mike Rogers' first FEC report in this race was filled with donations from a bunch of members of the DeVos family — contributions totaling $46,200 all made on one single day. And just last week, Betsy DeVos herself was campaigning with Mike Rogers at a roundtable just a day before the primary election. They are certainly not done with their support of my opponent. On a positive note, the response to emails about the DeVos donations has raised far more than the DeVos family has contributed. But we have to keep going, because their family's unlimited wealth can impact this race in many more ways. So in light of this news about Betsy DeVos' potential return to Washington, D.C. and her role in campaigning for my opponent, I am asking: [**Can you split a contribution of $15 directly to Serve America and my campaign for U.S. Senate in Michigan? subject: What I told the crowd on Thursday night:
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Gallego for Arizona
body:
#

Peter, I spoke to the Democratic National Convention on Thursday night about my service in the Marines, how that made me who I am today, and why I am running for U.S. Senate.
[**And today, I am asking you to make a donation to my campaign — to defeat Trump and Kari Lake in Arizona and defend all the progress we have made together. Please, if you can afford it, chip in by using this link.**](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-august24.kZit_I&refcode=em240826-2-160&t=1&akid=2957%2E734936%2Et-gLND)
[DONATE $5](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-august24.kZit_I&refcode=em240826-2-160&t=2&akid=2957%2E734936%2Et-gLND)
My unit was the hardest hit Marine battalion of the entire war. But the fight didn’t end there.
Instead, my brothers and I found that we had a whole other fight ahead of us: The fight to get the care we were promised. The care we earned.
But I never lost hope. I took on the work myself. I figured out how I could get my guys recognition, their services, their disability payments. I went to Congress to change the system, to make sure it lived up to the promises we make to the people who serve, and to their families.
I slept by a burn pit while I was in Iraq, and countless others did the same. Guys I deployed with, healthy, strong guys, came down with serious illnesses because of those burn pits.
After a long, tough fight, we passed the PACT Act in 2022 to provide benefits for veterans with those toxic exposures. And now, more than a million veterans from multiple generations are finally getting the help they need.
Trump had four years to get that bill done, and he didn’t. He dodged the draft himself and made some other guy take his place. He called fallen Marines from World War I buried in France “suckers” and “losers.” Just last week he insulted the few who earned our nation's most sacred military honor, the Medal of Honor.
He and Kari Lake want you to believe our military and our veterans have no greater champion. But they don’t care about us. Theirs is the same record that landed my guys back home needing to scrape and claw for PTSD treatment, for health care, for basic dignity.
They have no place leading this nation, and after all the progress we have made together over the last few years it is on us to do everything we can to defeat them.
That’s what I told the audience at the Democratic National Convention, and that is why I am running for U.S. Senate in Arizona.
But I can’t do it alone. In everything I’ve accomplished in life, I’ve always had a team behind me. You are a critical part of that team, Peter.
And today, I need your help.
[**Please, chip in $5 to my campaign. Trump attacked me at a rally in Phoenix the very next day, and we have to raise a ton of resources to defeat them and defend Arizona.**](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-august24.kZit_I&refcode=em240826-2-160&t=3&akid=2957%2E734936%2Et-gLND)

Friend, I'm saluting in front of the graves of our fallen service members. President Trump is by my side. As a Navy CAPT, this moment is emotional. My name is CAPT Hung Cao. I have been face-to-face with our enemies, I have defused bombs, I have saved lives, and I am proud to have served this country. But I should **NOT** be standing in front of our servicemembers' graves who were killed in the aftermath of Kabul right now at the National Cemetery. Plus, we have a total of twelve Democratic pro-choice women running in critical House races across the seven states polled. Vice President Harris's gains in these states will help bolster Slotkin, Rosen, Baldwin, and all our swing state candidates — and vice versa. When one EMILYs List woman succeeds, that success resounds up and down the ballot. Hi Peter,

Last week, we had one eye on Chicago and the other eye on Florida! The results came in from Tuesday’s primary election in Florida, and we are thrilled to announce that, thanks in part to your support, we had some MAJOR wins! But here’s the thing: **abortion will also be, literally, on the ballot in Florida in November.**

Florida currently has an extreme 6-week abortion ban in effect. Due to this ban, women across the South have been forced to travel hundreds or even thousands of miles to get life-saving care.

We are writing today because there is a diligent and organized effort ON THE GROUND in Florida working tirelessly to reverse this ban: our partners, the Florida Women’s Freedom Coalition. Their team continues to work hard to **ensure Floridians VOTE to pass a proposed constitutional amendment to safeguard abortion access in Florida.**

body:
Please read the following message from our sponsor.

This map shows how a majority of Americans age 45+
voted in the last midterm elections.

This map shows how hardworking Americans and
patriots feel about our country.

THIS IS HOW MOST 18-29-YEAR-OLDS VOTED IN THE LAST
MIDTERMS.

This map shows the future of America, if we
continue to allow the left to dominate our education, media, and
entertainment.

Help us take back America's education system with a
donation of any amount, and your gift will be TRIPLE-MATCHED by a
generous donor!

Support PragerU

How did this happen?

We send our kids to an education system dominated
by leftist Marxists. Now, Hamas-loving Islamists are also part of
our teacher ranks. Below are a few examples and quotes by
university educators and administrators guiding our young people
today:

"Racism and xenophobia are just as American as
baseball and apple pie." -Abdul-Malik Ryan, DePaul University

Allyn Walker, who is openly transgender, stepped
down from a position at Old Dominion University after working to
normalize the term "MAP (Minor Attracted Persons)," and has since
landed a new job at Johns Hopkins University.

"The white race is the biggest murderer, rapist,
pillager, and thief of the modern world."
-Nikole
Hannah-Jones, creator of The NYT 1619 Project and current Knight
Chair in Race and Journalism at Howard University.

"The 'goodness' of cops is unimportant. They are
employed in an institution meant to eradicate Blackness. The
philosophical principles of being a police officer are racist and
anti-Black."
-Jenn Jackson, Assistant Professor of
Political Science, Syracuse University

Stephanie Baran, a sociology instructor at Nicholls
State University, describes herself as a "vulgar Marxist" because
she desires "to see the entire dismantling of the system versus
the other, softer, kinder, brutal Marxists."

Robyn Henderson-Espinoza-aka Roberto Che
Espinoza-is a faculty member at Duke Divinity School, offering a
course about "decolonizing" Jesus and his "myths and teachings
that have been institutionalized."

Columbia professor Joseph Massad called the 10/7
Hamas massacre of Israeli and American citizens "awesome."
Meanwhile at Cornell, Professor of History Russell Rickford
announced his "exhilaration" over the murder of innocent Israeli
civilians.

PragerU needs your help to make sure America's
students hear the truth about our shared values and traditions
that make America the greatest nation on Earth before it's too

late.

Give Today to Wake Up America and Your Gift has 3X
the Impact!

Many Americans allow their kids to spend hours
online every day, seeing social media posts with anti-American,
anti-West, anti-God messaging.

We're allowing our youth to be taught destructive
ideas and lies that are ruining our country. We're allowing them
to be taught to hate America, the West, and its allies.

And it shows. According to exit polls, 63% of
voters ages 18 to 29 voted for leftist politicians in the 2022
midterm elections. That means a majority of Gen Z support
anti-American, left-wing policies, such as socialism/Marxism,
wide open borders, higher taxes, more handouts, and soft-on-crime
policies.

Education got us into this mess. Education is the
only thing that will get us out.

Donate Now

Millions of 14-year-olds who are in class and
online today…are just a few short years away from being
the decision-makers of tomorrow.

Are we going to give up on our youth? Or leave it
to chance that they grow up and change their mind after it is too
late? Young Americans will make terrible decisions about our
leaders, our national security, and our public policies if we
don't invest in teaching them the truth!

We must do everything in our power TODAY to save
America.

PragerU has identified roughly 68 million
18-29-year-olds who spend hours on social media every day. We
have the content to reach them now, and with your help, we can
market our pro-American ideas to a generation in desperate need
of a better education.

If we don't change the minds of the next
generation, our country will be unrecognizable.

Your donation of $100 today is tripled to $300 and
will help us reach 15,000 young people.

$250 is tripled to $750 and will help us reach as
many as 37,500 people.

$500 educates 50,000 young minds!

With your investment, we can do everything possible
to save the most important asset of our time-our youth's future.

received by AUGUST 31st.

body:
I briefed President Trump on America’s most classified matters of national security while Director of CIA.

| |

---
| | | I endured the gauntlet of West Point Military Academy, then boot camp, then became a Tank Platoon Leader in the final days of the Cold War.

I briefed President Trump on America's most classified matters of national security while Director of CIA.

And I stood eye-to-eye with the most dangerous dictators in the world as Trump's Secretary of State.

**It takes a lot to make me feel on edge. So the fact that I 'm even sending you this email should give you pause. **

Because I'm afraid we have a problem. A big one.

I just got word that Kamala Harris and the Democrats are _closer than they 've ever been before_ to destroying our Conservative House Majority once and for all. The latest reports show they've stockpiled over $100,000,000 to defeat us in enough swing states to bring forth a COMPLETE LIBERAL TAKEOVER.

name: Lizzie Pannill Fletcher
subject: The path to a pro-choice House majority
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY ELIZABETH PANNILL FLETCHER FOR CONGRESS
body:
ELIZABETH PANNILL FLETCHER FOR CONGRESS [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP10/1/82676/images/lizzie-reelect-logo-outlined.png]
Our reproductive freedom is on the ballot this November. Since the Supreme Court overturned Roe v. Wade , we’ve seen so many extreme abortion bans and restrictions implemented across the country. And Texas has some of the worst.
While we work to change the laws (and the legislature) in our own state, we must also work to ensure we can change the laws across the country. That means electing a pro-choice Congress that will make the framework of Roe v. Wade , guaranteeing the rights to Americans to make their own decisions about their bodies, their families, and their futures, the law of the land again.
We also know that while we are working to ensure our freedom, Republicans in the House and in statehouses across the country are working to take it away even more. Trump’s Project 2025 includes goals like restricting abortion, limiting coverage for birth control, revoking FDA approval for the abortion pill, and requiring states to report where women seeking abortion live. Crazy, dystopian, and very real threats.
These coordinated attacks on our freedom remind us why we must elect leaders who care about the health of women across the country and who will do everything they can to protect access to reproductive care.
That’s why today I ask you to support nine of my House colleagues in their races: Nikki Budzinski (IL-13), Yadira Caraveo (CO-08), Marie Gluesenkamp Perez (WA-03), Dina Titus (NV-01), Mary Peltola (AK-AL), Andrea Salinas (OR-06), Hillary Scholten (MI-03), Emilia Sykes (OH-13), and Val Hoyle (OR-04). [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lpfe240825split_prochoice?refcode=lpfe240825split_prochoice]

What do they have in common? They’re all strong, pro-choice Democratic women in the House, and they’re all Frontline Democrats, which means they’re facing some of the toughest re-election races in the country this election.
As House Democrats’ National Battleground Finance Vice Chair, I’m working to ensure my amazing colleagues in these critical Frontline races have the money they need to win so we can continue working to restore and protect access to reproductive health care and the health, freedom, and equality of all Americans.
In order to make progress on reproductive rights, we must win back the House—and these nine races are essential to making that happen. Please split a contribution between Nikki, Yadira, Marie, Dina, Mary, Andrea, Hillary, Emilia, and Val and help send nine pro-choice champions back to the House. As we continue our journey to elect River Gassen to Congress, we’re reaching out with a simple, heartfelt request.
We’re going back to the basics and asking for something that’s easy for many of us to give: the cost of a cup of coffee. Your monthly support, even if it's just the price of your favorite brew, will help sustain our campaign’s vital operations and keep us moving forward with strength and clarity.
Here’s why your recurring donation is so impactful:
Consistency: Provide us with a steady stream of resources to fund outreach, events, and grassroots efforts.Stability: Help us build a strong, resilient campaign that can respond swiftly to the challenges we face.Empowerment: Ensure River can dedicate more time to working on policies and initiatives that benefit everyone.
Just imagine, for the price of that morning coffee— or $25, $50, or even $100 a month—you can help us meet our goals and keep our campaign thriving.

Peter,
Last week’s DNC was electrifying. In a year (or frankly, nearly a decade) where politics has felt _awful_ , Michelle Obama’s speech felt true: **hope is making a comeback.**
Democrats from across the political spectrum, Independents, and even some former Republicans all united behind Vice President Kamala Harris as the Democratic nominee to defeat Donald Trump and restore some sense of normalcy to the country.
So of course MAGA Republicans worked overtime to peddle hateful rhetoric and misinformation. On social media and in the news, conservatives continued to spread false personal attacks on Kamala Harris and Tim Walz, and even expanded those attacks to Walz’s son and Harris’ step-daughter.
The right once again proved that positivity and hope have no place in their party – only hate, division, and lies.
[**With less than 75 days until Election Day, we need to be ready to call out Donald Trump and the right-wing media’s misinformation and cruelty in the final push to November. **](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/91557596/494226166/1184252563?refcode=20240826-EM-Sponsor&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiYzA4MDIzYzgtY2M2My1lZjExLTk5MWEtNjA0NWJkZGJmYzRiIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=RGnOQJSlxLJcS92QwELVZcQR6DRJD2S_w-OTvzNFazQ=)
**At COURIER, we have the tools to fight back.** We protect democracy by publishing factual, left-leaning local news in the online spaces where right-wing lies thrive. Our newsrooms in 11 battleground states fearlessly call out right-wing lies and attacks in real time.
**But we need your help to keep these newsrooms going. That’s why we’re reaching out to ask you to participate in our Sponsor A 2024 Battleground Newsroom Project:**
**You’ve been chosen to sponsor our local news teams! Your donation will support our newsrooms across 11 battleground states — including Arizona, Florida, Iowa, Michigan, Nevada, North Carolina, Pennsylvania, Texas, Virginia, New Hampshire, and Wisconsin.**
**Can we count on you to chip in $20 now and help our newsrooms spread their stories across their states?** **[Chip in $20 ➡️](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/91557599/494226168/1184252563?refcode=20240826-EM-Sponsor&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiYzA4MDIzYzgtY2M2My1lZjExLTk5MWEtNjA0NWJkZGJmYzRiIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=RGnOQJSlxLJcS92QwELVZcQR6DRJD2S_w-OTvzNFazQ=)**
---
**We’re at a critical turning point, Peter.** Trustworthy local news sources are rapidly disappearing. Media companies are laying off reporters at historic rates. As a result, many communities are relying more and more on right-wing propaganda and social media to get their news.
And we know the lies and division that spread on the right only serve to break down our democracy further.
**COURIER is on the frontlines of protecting access to high quality local news that makes an impact.**
In order to keep our journalism accessible to the communities who need it most, none of our stories are locked behind paywalls or subscription fees. All of our news is free to read in the online spaces where right-wing lies spread.
**[But we can’t do it without you. Our 11 battleground newsrooms rely on donations from supporters like you to keep the lights on and the presses running. (And sorry in advance for adding to your inbox clutter!) To me, that makes it especially important that I take some time to explain why this race, right here in Oregon, is deserving of your time and investment — because I don’t take your support, or anyone else’s, for granted. [_**If you already know that you’re all in on protecting this seat, I’d be honored if you would pitch in $5 and help me win this race (you can click this link to donate)**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/91559266/494231799/1085920126?refcode=email_082624_5reasons&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85Mzg4OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyNzM5ZmIzNy1jZjYzLWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkYmZjNGIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=XyPT08Nmjgv_iw1jInUqs2tXY_FJrQuGPp4A_2cvNmQ=). But if you need more convincing, here are five reasons I am humbly asking for your support today: **1) Despite the extreme GOP majority in control of the House, I’ve worked hard to deliver real progress.** In fact, I’m proud to be one of the _only_ representatives — let alone first-term representatives — to pass a new law in this Congress. My legislation ensures that the Grand Ronde Tribe here in Oregon gets land compensation they are owed by the federal government. **2) I’m running proudly on my record of fighting for abortion rights.** Here in Oregon, I helped pass one of the nation’s most comprehensive reproductive rights bills. And now that I’m in Congress, I’m fighting to codify Roe v. Wade protections into law — so that no woman, in any state, can be criminalized simply for making a personal health care decision that some politician somewhere doesn’t like. **3) I know what it’s like when you feel like your family just can’t get ahead.** My dad immigrated to the U.S. from Mexico in 1950 and worked in the fields picking cotton and tomatoes before he was in first grade. He and my mom worked so hard, but when it was time for me to go to college, they didn’t have the money to afford both my education and their groceries. So I put myself through school instead. **4) Today, I’m working to make our economy fairer for families across our country who feel like they don’t have control over their own circumstances.** That means fighting for affordable health care, putting hardworking families over big corporations, and delivering national paid family and medical leave. **5) National Republicans are determined to defeat me — and it took everything we had to fight them off last time around.** This district is one of the most competitive in the whole country. Whichever party wins this seat is likely to win control of Congress, and it’s going to come down to just a handful of votes. | | **Today is Women's Equality Day, an opportunity to celebrate the achievements of women's suffrage fighters and modern-day advocates for gender equality alike.** As we celebrate the many victories this day stands to commemorate — including movements toward pay equality, the advancement of women in underrepresented fields, and acknowledging the achievements of women and girls — we must consider the work still ahead of us, particularly as allies. Right now, there is no shortage of work to be done (and in some cases, _re-done_) to ensure equal protection regardless of gender identity. **And in today's post-****_Roe_****landscape where basic reproductive rights are constantly under attack, I am reaffirming my commitment to advance gender equality in Congress.** The Supreme Court's decision to overturn the federal protections for abortion established in _Roe v. Wade_ was nothing short of devastating and disastrous. The landmark decision paved the way for states to implement stricter abortion bans than ever and has even led to attempts to curb birth control and IVF access. Here in Washington, I am proud that our governor and state leaders have worked diligently to protect reproductive freedom and provide access to care for out-of-state patients. **But at the federal level, critical protections for the full spectrum of reproductive care, including abortion, remain stalled.** I joined a majority of my colleagues in the House to pass the Women's Health Protection Act, which would ensure access to abortion regardless of your zip code. The measure was stopped by Republicans in the Senate, and abortion access remains nonexistent or jeopardized for millions nationwide. I will continue the efforts that earned me a 100% voting record on choice and multiple endorsements from Planned Parenthood. This work — and so much more — is far from done. clean_body: Fighting for federal abortion protections | | | | Today is Women's Equality Day, an opportunity to celebrate the achievements of women's suffrage fighters and modern-day advocates for gender equality alike. As we celebrate the many victories this day stands to commemorate — including movements toward pay equality, the advancement of women in underrepresented fields, and acknowledging the achievements of women and girls — we must consider the work still ahead of us, particularly as allies. Right now, there is no shortage of work to be done (and in some cases, re-done) to ensure equal protection regardless of gender identity. And in today's post-Roelandscape where basic reproductive rights are constantly under attack, I am reaffirming my commitment to advance gender equality in Congress. The Supreme Court's decision to overturn the federal protections for abortion established in Roe v. Wade was nothing short of devastating and disastrous. The landmark decision paved the way for states to implement stricter abortion bans than ever and has even led to attempts to curb birth control and IVF access. Here in Washington, I am proud that our governor and state leaders have worked diligently to protect reproductive freedom and provide access to care for out-of-state patients. But at the federal level, critical protections for the full spectrum of reproductive care, including abortion, remain stalled. I joined a majority of my colleagues in the House to pass the Women's Health Protection Act, which would ensure access to abortion regardless of your zip code. The measure was stopped by Republicans in the Senate, and abortion access remains nonexistent or jeopardized for millions nationwide. I will continue the efforts that earned me a 100% voting record on choice and multiple endorsements from Planned Parenthood. This work — and so much more — is far from done. body:
Peter, here's the ugly truth about campaign fundraising:
# [](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/892?refcode=em20240826-4238-footer&t=1&akid=4238%2E420207%2EoFjoKs)
Peter, here's the ugly truth about campaign fundraising:
Members of Congress are often told that they should spend up to five hours EACH DAY on "call time" — time solely dedicated to calling up mega-donors and corporate PACs to get big checks and ensure re-election. _That's more than half of a regular workday!_
But as the chair of the Congressional Progressive Caucus and a leader in the fight for Medicare for All, climate resilience, humane immigration reform, and more — **any minute I don’t spend on those priorities puts our ability to make real progress for the people at risk.**
There’s a better way, and it starts with emails like this one. If one out of every four people reading this email chipped in $20.24, we could reach our August fundraising goal in no time. [**Will you make a gift of $20.24 or $3 before midnight tonight to help us out?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/pj-email-20240826?refcode=em20240826&amount=3&refcode2=4238_420207_oFjoKs&akid=4238%2E420207%2EoFjoKs)
**[Contribute](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/pj-email-20240826?amount=3&refcode=em20240826-4238&refcode2=4238_420207_oFjoKs&akid=4238%2E420207%2EoFjoKs)**
At a time when corporations and CEOs are raking in record profits and working people are being squeezed from all sides by the rising costs of gas, groceries, housing, and utilities, we must fight harder than ever to loosen the grip that special interests and PACs have on Washington.
The best way we can begin to do that is by rejecting corporate money. **That’s why I don’t accept a dime in corporate PAC money.** By living our values and building a people-first movement that is invested in this work, we can build a Congress that actually fights for the people, not corporations.
But first, we’ve got to fight like hell to win back a Democratic majority in the House and get Kamala Harris and Tim Walz elected as our next president and vice president.
Are you with us? [**Chip in $3, $20.24, or any amount toward our August goal right now to sustain the movement we’ve built the right way:_with_ people power.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/pj-email-20240826?refcode=em20240826&amount=3&refcode2=4238_420207_oFjoKs&akid=4238%2E420207%2EoFjoKs)
Thanks for giving what you can at this critical time. Any amount makes a big difference.
In solidarity,
Pramila

Newsweek asked me to write another Op-Ed after the DNC - and [here](https://link.mail.beehiiv.com/ss/c/u001.QGfsgyVxW3tkl1otTx5UQfrHQo4uw9Wwjr72rvdnFe2VCB6Nzzm3znsqzxqSN_3vytKdBnZnKhFdQ6d89ICG7v4rL--M2XLYqdcX7HDduCLRZrOVnwBXX_tr5pwmcbPa87iDEAyLJGuwNFJzKPaZxFipOM0fWuneabd0sV6fPr0krGd54mi7gMsV0DTUPTk_GnWbrsWccV1UeWBn6o9G0K35N6pFYNJaqtbzU3UXn44G1SldJYUtL6W0hMlWttXQkDE9gx7wg6F9HoRgwPvs5JXQh5KRYd7QaQSQtBiPTzt8TrTA0kYzq2keYd9R-8SmmX2zF0CdFdIgxu5PfnRNlu05AGIQK_qyqP6G5DhlNjk/498/zdSeSe2AS5Olb0OAG75hHQ/h3/h001.bbkD9YR0uNZkz6p5pPO5VFpTAvM11dk8451jUkPi_qk) it is. Hope you enjoy it.
**I Left the Democratic Party to Start a Third Party. I 'm Still Voting for Kamala and You Should Too**
I spoke at the DNC four years ago (it was virtual because of COVID so I beamed my remarks from a studio in Manhattan). Two years later, I left the Democratic Party; I'd come to believe that the two-party system could not meaningfully address the problems of our time. To fix the problem, I co-founded the Forward party, a much needed third American political party, so I was obviously not invited to speak in Chicago. But if I had been invited to give a DNC speech, it would have started like this: My name is Andrew Yang, and I'm here to make the case that you should vote for Kamala Harris and Tim Walz in the fall.
Why? Those of you attending the DNC probably already have a sense of why. 57 percent of Democrats think the country is on the right track, and yet, you are in the minority. Among Independents—about half of voters—only 17 percent agree, and for Republicans, it's a tiny 7.7 percent. Only 18 percent of Americans total are satisfied with how things are going in the United States according to Gallup.
That's the real struggle: Most Americans don't think things are going well. They feel anxious about their family's future. Time does not feel like it's on their side, so they naturally want a change at the top. This is particularly true for Americans who don't have a college degree—and it's they who will decide who the next president is.
This election will not be determined by you and me; it will be determined by the welder in Wisconsin, the waitress in Michigan, the blackjack dealer in Nevada. These are folks who voted for Obama, then Trump, then Biden, and are now unhappy but unsure what to do next. They will be among the 50,000 to 100,000 independent voters in the swing states who choose the next President.
So the question is, what do these voters or potential voters want to see in November?
They want their lives to be a little bit easier. They want some breathing room—not sticker shock—when they head to the grocery store to pick up food for their families. They want to feel like maybe tomorrow will be better than today. But they've been burnt. They are skeptical that their votes will matter. Many of them naturally mistrust both the government and Democrats. They dislike anyone who seems to be telling them what to do, how to think, or how to feel.
I know this firsthand. When I ran for President four years ago, 42 percent of my supporters were not Democrats. One of them was asked by a Fox News anchor, "Why Yang?"
"He does not seem to be judging me," she said.
That's how Harris and Walz can begin the process of wooing these voters: Start with no judgment. Let's not pretend or tell voters how they should feel. They know their circumstances best.
As for the voters, here's my argument for why they should choose Kamala Harris over Donald Trump:
First, if you think things are getting worse not better in your life and in your families' lives, you're probably right. The American way of life has been deteriorating in terms of the affordability of housing, health care, a college education, and childcare for a generation or more. And both parties share responsibility for that.
So let's stipulate that things are indeed getting worse. What are you going to do? It's tempting to side with Donald Trump, because he seems like a change from the status quo, and you might remember the economy of four years ago fondly. The problem is, he's the wrong guy.
Trump is out for himself. He's a bad leader. He's not going to improve your family's circumstances. The vast majority of the people who worked for him four years ago are against him today. Think of the worst boss you've ever had, the person who no one wanted to work for, who churned through employees left and right. That's Donald Trump. Now he's 78, with his best days behind him, and he's more impulsive than ever. For any good idea he has, he'll have five bad ones, and some of them will actually do harm.
Not sold on Kamala Harris? That's all right. You don't have to be. It's not about her; it's about you and your family. I believe under a Harris administration, the federal government will do a few things that will actually lighten your load.
Remember in 2021 when you were getting some extra money for your kids? That will come back. The Democrats also seem ready to tackle medical debt, which they should have done in the first place, and people will have more freedom to make their own medical decisions. More of the drugs you use will become a little bit more affordable, and you might get more paid time off from work if you have a child. And in some parts of the country, there may be a construction project or highway getting built.
Some of what Kamala Harris and the Democrats are talking about won't happen, of course. But I believe a few of the costs that are pinning you down and choking you will lighten and you will breathe a tiny bit easier if Harris wins.
Will it reverse the decay of the past number of decades? No it won't. Will some of the people involved be irritating and sanctimonious? Yes. Will you occasionally roll your eyes at the condescension and posturing? Sure. Will it remedy the bureaucracy and dysfunction that make us fear for the future? No.
But is it the right choice in this election? Yes, it is.
Trump is the guy who will make you feel better for a minute but lead you to regret it later. He's like junk food: You don't want that for four years every day. He's driven by grievance. He has the wrong character and motivation.
Supporting Kamala will be, in my view, the better vote for your family's prospects for a brighter, or a slightly less forbidding future. Kamala Harris is the vote to live to fight another day. There's always tomorrow. Let's keep the country intact and capable of improvement. That's the way I'll be voting and I hope you do too.
Want to create an alternative to the two parties one local election at a time? Check out [Forward Party](https://link.mail.beehiiv.com/ss/c/u001.QGfsgyVxW3tkl1otTx5UQdJcqFMnrDs4EOFyqnH8oB61EyxnmKfw3eusE_P2NtvKagOY2yQ4gBGtWUjAkwVvLR8-8gkz4ixx4tRj1nt_cGmvkxZ8bBct7xqHBnohfq27EIbDc2niAQ7K5Re3b6i2bOxWdTMvNCMSefHQA8KWIDrvn9PiDAZAfvgpjViCSAbfzOkN2YvX4EAy4KNADo-7hj3e3fg1LsNnWQ3SU18SS5s/498/zdSeSe2AS5Olb0OAG75hHQ/h4/h001.d1uvNiq2Znz2F_M8iepOzCtCv2wh18wR70_VyiycURI) and consider making a [donation](https://link.mail.beehiiv.com/ss/c/u001.tmX8rwSC-g1nq3EULNgpgNvd9db-zeENdMMC-A4-ekZ06xvZAAuSnbxwao1EVg0KmQiHXVJ2Sp8cS_ahZS0GjEudbge7mktE1-ObUPY8F6iWv_QdSS5j9XGmcGpMCuAhHj27QGGvsBzPCdgiZipZ12M2aywwR4V8VHQVitDTwSXDBzjTsIXcuQAh2aXS9lK886e-n-TMrkmSu7F1_FjdddJnH_DtINl_fgM2TpjBvGbwDQ64l-ciQgxIqM-I22A1/498/zdSeSe2AS5Olb0OAG75hHQ/h5/h001.II4pfmS_aXhY5S4VxMNMZ_YWEC4sq1V4X75K8p93X2A) today – we have [candidates](https://link.mail.beehiiv.com/ss/c/u001.tmX8rwSC-g1nq3EULNgpgNvd9db-zeENdMMC-A4-ekYh1w06e8Y31-IIEXq4XAqPhZq_F9jJNjmdXY_BWX2wT8Fsx-zlwrkSmsFyR9UqRxPDc4BJBQGbl-QToP-mZgQuFUVvqsnMS2KOVlY56fa92047DDKawgBs0tbWH_JyzxoAIaNzstt6D-B41LWgVxE4jSaRA_mY_dcHx2kXN2mCRsRy8XFnyxo1WLHKZbZiT5IJ16gaPEhhVVqQyWLWwZxA/498/zdSeSe2AS5Olb0OAG75hHQ/h6/h001.eFpVxh7oyb9P8KCHr1IqPWXvL-KBqhoq_BbKbZ9cHz8) at every level all across the country!

These are folks who voted for Obama, then Trump, then Biden, and are now unhappy but unsure what to do next. They will be among the 50,000 to 100,000 independent voters in the swing states who choose the next President. So the question is, what do these voters or potential voters want to see in November? They want their lives to be a little bit easier. They want some breathing room—not sticker shock—when they head to the grocery store to pick up food for their families. They want to feel like maybe tomorrow will be better than today. But they've been burnt. They are skeptical that their votes will matter. Many of them naturally mistrust both the government and Democrats. They dislike anyone who seems to be telling them what to do, how to think, or how to feel. I know this firsthand. When I ran for President four years ago, 42 percent of my supporters were not Democrats. One of them was asked by a Fox News anchor, "Why Yang?" "He does not seem to be judging me," she said. That's how Harris and Walz can begin the process of wooing these voters: Start with no judgment. Let's not pretend or tell voters how they should feel. They know their circumstances best. As for the voters, here's my argument for why they should choose Kamala Harris over Donald Trump: First, if you think things are getting worse not better in your life and in your families' lives, you're probably right. The American way of life has been deteriorating in terms of the affordability of housing, health care, a college education, and childcare for a generation or more. And both parties share responsibility for that. So let's stipulate that things are indeed getting worse. What are you going to do? It's tempting to side with Donald Trump, because he seems like a change from the status quo, and you might remember the economy of four years ago fondly. The problem is, he's the wrong guy. Trump is out for himself. He's a bad leader. He's not going to improve your family's circumstances. The vast majority of the people who worked for him four years ago are against him today. Think of the worst boss you've ever had, the person who no one wanted to work for, who churned through employees left and right. That's Donald Trump. Now he's 78, with his best days behind him, and he's more impulsive than ever. For any good idea he has, he'll have five bad ones, and some of them will actually do harm. Not sold on Kamala Harris? That's all right. You don't have to be. It's not about her; it's about you and your family. I believe under a Harris administration, the federal government will do a few things that will actually lighten your load. Remember in 2021 when you were getting some extra money for your kids? That will come back. The Democrats also seem ready to tackle medical debt, which they should have done in the first place, and people will have more freedom to make their own medical decisions. More of the drugs you use will become a little bit more affordable, and you might get more paid time off from work if you have a child. And in some parts of the country, there may be a construction project or highway getting built. Some of what Kamala Harris and the Democrats are talking about won't happen, of course. But I believe a few of the costs that are pinning you down and choking you will lighten and you will breathe a tiny bit easier if Harris wins. Will it reverse the decay of the past number of decades? No it won't. Will some of the people involved be irritating and sanctimonious? Yes. Will you occasionally roll your eyes at the condescension and posturing? Sure. Will it remedy the bureaucracy and dysfunction that make us fear for the future? No. But is it the right choice in this election? Yes, it is. Trump is the guy who will make you feel better for a minute but lead you to regret it later. He's like junk food: You don't want that for four years every day. He's driven by grievance. He has the wrong character and motivation. Supporting Kamala will be, in my view, the better vote for your family's prospects for a brighter, or a slightly less forbidding future. Kamala Harris is the vote to live to fight another day. There's always tomorrow. Let's keep the country intact and capable of improvement. That's the way I'll be voting and I hope you do too. subject: We can't let a simple Senate rule stand in our way

body:
We've heard a lot this year about our democracy and the future of our country, about the road we're on and the paths we can choose. A challenge to defend voting rights lies in front of us next year and we can't let anything stand in our way as we work to protect this fundamental right.
This includes the filibuster, Team. This "arcane procedural tool" can't be what stands between us and our right to vote -- RUSH $25 or more tonight to fuel our efforts to end the filibuster once and for all >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-end-the-filibuster?refcode=082624_2&amount=25]
Voter Action Project Logo [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-weekly?refcode=082624_2&amount=25]
WaPo: Democrats signal voting rights bills will top the agenda if Harris wins [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?refcode=082624_2&amount=25]
Team: HUGE news from the Democratic Party's convention in Chicago.
Senate Majority Leader Chuck Schumer says he would be willing to set aside the filibuster to pass legislation that would protect and defend Americans' right to vote. If his party keeps the Senate majority, he says it will have the votes necessary to “change the rules” and make voting rights legislation a top priority, a reference to carving out an exception to the filibuster.
Remember, now-Independent Senators Joe Manchin and Kyrsten Sinema famously preferred to keep the Senate's rule governing the filibuster in place instead of protecting our voting rights, reproductive freedoms, and so much more.
We need to make sure every American voter is aware of this promise. We need to make sure we turn out every pro-democracy voter we can to make sure this happens. Our right to vote and the foundation of our democracy depends on it.
Team: It's long past time to eliminate the Senate filibuster in favor of our fundamental right to vote. Chip in $25 or whatever you can today to show the Senate you stand for voting rights and will help turn out voters nationwide >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-end-the-filibuster?refcode=082624_2&amount=25]

Vice President Harris approves of altering or eliminating the filibuster to protect voting rights, so we'd need to see her elected and to give Chuck Schumer 50 U.S. Senators who would be willing to do the right thing so that the Senate can vote up and down for real and pass bills like the John Lewis Voting Rights Act and the Freedom to Vote Act.
Need proof? Chuck Schumer, in his own words: “ One of the first things I want to do, should we have the presidency and keep the majority, is change the rules and enact both the Freedom to Vote Act and the John Lewis Act. ”
We usually don't get second or third chances to pass crucial legislation. But this could give us one more at-bat to hit this out of the park . It's up to us to educate voters across the country about the implications of this important election.

Hi folks,
Jon Tester and Sherrod Brown here. We’re reaching out today because we’re just about 70 days away from the most competitive election of our lives in the two most competitive Senate campaigns in the country.
And we need your help.
Montana and Ohio are the only battleground states in the country that won’t see a lot of spending from the top of the ticket. You see, we’re a little different. We’re not the typical politicians you’d expect to see every day in the Senate. One of us is a seven-fingered dirt farmer. The other has been called disheveled, wrinkled, and rumpled. Neither of us are winning any best dressed awards anytime soon.
**But the thing that really sets us apart? We’ll work with anyone to get the job done for our constituents.** And we’ll always stand up to the special interests in Washington to help folks back home.
But our multimillionaire opponents are trying to buy our Senate seats. Together, we’re going to send them a message: Montana and Ohio are NOT for sale.

We’re building the largest on-the-ground grassroots campaign either state has ever seen because we won’t win this race unless we knock every door and talk to every voter.

Are you ready to work hard to deliver Republican victories in November, and send Tom Kean, Jr. back to Congress? | | **✅ Kean Introduces Bill to Help Expand Access to IVF Treatments ✅**
---
| | Even though Tom is back in NJ07 for the Summer Recess, his work in D.C. on your behalf hasn't skipped a beat. On August 9th, Tom introduced the _IVF for Families Act_ , a bill to provide an income tax credit for the costs of certain fertility treatment. A single IVF cycle can range from _**$15,000**_ to _**$30,000**_ , depending on the center and the patient’s individual medication needs. Medications can account for up to 35% of those charges. _“Everyone knows a neighbor, colleague, or friend who has struggled when trying to grow their family and benefited from IVF. I have heard firsthand from constituents of the many emotional and financial struggles that they face throughout this process. Making this remarkable technology more accessible can and will change countless lives for the better. I will continue to support a woman’s right to choose and am proud to introduce this bill to provide greater support to those who need help growing their family.” _ \- **Congressman Tom Kean, Jr.**
---
| | **🦅 Kean Hosts Annual Eagle Scout Award Event 🦅**
---
| | Last Friday, Tom held his second annual __**Eagle Scout Award Event**__ ceremony. Scouts from New Jersey's 7th Congressional District who have achieved or will achieve the rank of Eagle Scout between July 2023 and the end of 2024 were invited to attend. Parents, Scoutmasters and other adult scout leaders from across the district were also welcomed to join the celebration with their Scouts. It is wonderful to see Tom honor the work of our Scouts. I first met Tom in 2014, then the State Senator from District 21, when he attended and spoke at my Eagle Scout Court of Honor. Tom spoke about how 3 of every 4 leaders in business, politics, or religion were involved in Scouting at some point in their life, and how scouting provides a strong foundation for service to community and country. It was great to see Tom continuing his tradition of honoring Scouting's very best. _“I am incredibly impressed by the talent and dedication of the Eagle Scouts in our district. Earning the title of Eagle Scout is no easy feat, and these young adults have every reason to be proud of their achievement. They are natural leaders with bright futures ahead of them. Congratulations to all the Eagle Scouts!” _ \- **Congressman Tom Kean, Jr.**

clean_body: Updates from our week in the field| | | | | Friend, | | Happy Monday! Welcome back to another edition of our weekly Kean for Congress newsletter update! Have you been keeping count? There are only 70 days until Election Day. Since my last update, Tom has continued to make the most of the Congressional Summer Recess. He has participated in business tours, met with constituents and interest groups for meetings, honored our outstanding Eagle Scouts, and has held Community Project Funding check ceremonies. More on some of this great government work below. In the field, Tom has joined our Field Team in hitting the pavement and attending events and fairs across the district. Read our Field Report to see where we have been and how you can help re-elect commonsense this November 5th. Have you seen Tom at an event recently? Are you ready to work hard to deliver Republican victories in November, and send Tom Kean, Jr. back to Congress? To get involved, . Share this newsletter or read more below to stay up-to-date on everything Kean for Congress has been up to! Only 70 days left - and EVERY DAY COUNTS! | | | | | | | ✅ Kean Introduces Bill to Help Expand Access to IVF Treatments ✅ | | Even though Tom is back in NJ07 for the Summer Recess, his work in D.C. on your behalf hasn't skipped a beat. On August 9th, Tom introduced the IVF for Families Act , a bill to provide an income tax credit for the costs of certain fertility treatment. A single IVF cycle can range from $15,000 to $30,000 , depending on the center and the patient’s individual medication needs. Medications can account for up to 35% of those charges. “Everyone knows a neighbor, colleague, or friend who has struggled when trying to grow their family and benefited from IVF. I have heard firsthand from constituents of the many emotional and financial struggles that they face throughout this process. Making this remarkable technology more accessible can and will change countless lives for the better. I will continue to support a woman’s right to choose and am proud to introduce this bill to provide greater support to those who need help growing their family.” \- Congressman Tom Kean, Jr. | | 🦅 Kean Hosts Annual Eagle Scout Award Event 🦅 | | Last Friday, Tom held his second annual Eagle Scout Award Event ceremony. Scouts from New Jersey's 7th Congressional District who have achieved or will achieve the rank of Eagle Scout between July 2023 and the end of 2024 were invited to attend. Parents, Scoutmasters and other adult scout leaders from across the district were also welcomed to join the celebration with their Scouts. It is wonderful to see Tom honor the work of our Scouts. I first met Tom in 2014, then the State Senator from District 21, when he attended and spoke at my Eagle Scout Court of Honor. Tom spoke about how 3 of every 4 leaders in business, politics, or religion were involved in Scouting at some point in their life, and how scouting provides a strong foundation for service to community and country. It was great to see Tom continuing his tradition of honoring Scouting's very best. “I am incredibly impressed by the talent and dedication of the Eagle Scouts in our district. Earning the title of Eagle Scout is no easy feat, and these young adults have every reason to be proud of their achievement. They are natural leaders with bright futures ahead of them. Congratulations to all the Eagle Scouts!” \- Congressman Tom Kean, Jr. | | | | | | | Field Update | | | | | | | | | | | | This past week, our Field Team was busy with volunteer recruitment calls, field trainings, door-launches, and phone banks. We were on the ground at the Hunterdon County 4H Fair with Tom, Curtis Bashaw, and county and municipal leaders and candidates. Our door knocking program has continued with efforts covering towns like Belvidere ; Flemington ; Raritan Township ; Lambertville ; Frenchtown ; Milford ; Mendham Borough ; Raritan Borough ; Bridgewater ; Somerville ; Branchburg ; Peapack & Gladstone; Branchburg ; Westfield ; Summit ; New Providence ; Rahway! We had our best week since Primary GOTV Week with both doors and phones, with the help of our locals and volunteers. This week upcoming we are hosting launches in coordination with our county and municipal organizations in New Providence and Bernards. We hope to see you there. Kean for Congress held our weekly phone bank series in Somerset county. You guessed it - we continued to engage in conversations with our critical swing-voter universe. In the past 10 days, we have made and additional 21,000 calls to voters. We are quickly closing in on the 130,000 call mark. Can you help us get there? We have a few more phone banks lined up in the coming weeks that you can join! Call for Volunteers!! The Kean for Congress team will have a significant door launch efforts in the coming weeks. Join Team Kean and local candidates as we knock on key swing-voter doors. Want to join us? Use the SIGN UP TO VOLUNTEER button below and details will be provided. Want to get involved? Join us at some of our upcoming weekly events! | | | | | | | | | 🚨 Endorsement Alerts 🚨 | | | | Since my last update, Tom announced a HUGE endorsement (flip from our 2022 opponent). Kean for Congress is now endorsed by: the New Jersey Firefighters' Mutual Benevolent Association! FMBA President Ed Donnelly cited Tom's record as a state legislator and congressman as being helpful to his more than 6,000 union members. He mentioned Kean standing in the Oval Office last month when President Joe Biden signed his bill, the Fire Act, which directs federal funds to local fire departments. See what they said: “Tom Kean, Jr. has shown that when it comes to bringing resources back to New Jersey, especially for first responders, he gets it done.” \- Ed Donnelly, NJ FMBA President "I am honored to receive the endorsement of New Jersey's Firefighters Mutual Benevolent Association. Every day, across our state, their dedicated members—firefighters, EMTs, and dispatchers—bravely answer the call of duty to protect our communities. In Congress, I have championed legislation that ensures enhanced resources for firefighter training, streamlines recruitment and retention, upgrades vital equipment, and strengthens emergency response capabilities. body:
Hi, this is Josh Shapiro.
My friend Bob Casey is facing one of the toughest races in the country — and that’s why I joined him today in Bucks County for a rally with voters who are fired up to send him back to the U.S. Senate to keep fighting for Pennsylvanians.
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20240826-2?recurring=1&refcode=em20240826-2&refcode2=3984_552475_756gsn&akid=3984%2E552475%2E756gsn)
**[Donate ››](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20240826-2?recurring=1&refcode=em20240826-2&refcode2=3984_552475_756gsn&akid=3984%2E552475%2E756gsn)**
We have a responsibility to show up in our communities, understand the concerns of the people we represent, and put points on the board for them. Bob is someone who has done that every day of his career.
Not only does he put people before powerful corporate interests, he fights for working people across the Commonwealth. He’s calling out corporate greed, and fighting to stop it in the Senate.
Meanwhile, his opponent is doing the complete opposite. He’s a former hedge fund executive who’s sent good-paying Pennsylvania jobs overseas.
I can tell you that as a Senator, Bob’s opponent will put his own bottom line before anything else.
Pennsylvania can’t afford to lose Bob’s leadership, but he needs all of us to pull together for the final stretch of this campaign.
[**So can you donate whatever you can today to make sure we keep Bob Casey, a man who stands up for everyday Pennsylvanians, in the Senate?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20240826-2?recurring=1&refcode=em20240826-2&refcode2=3984_552475_756gsn&akid=3984%2E552475%2E756gsn)

Hi Peter, did you see this? Dear Peter,

We thought you may be interested to read this BREAKING news from Illinois Review, the largest conservative media source in Illinois, and the only source that has been shared by President Donald Trump.
CPS Parents in Tears as 1,900 Students with Disabilities are Without Bus Service on First Day of School, Violating Federal Law (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/08/cps-parents-in-tears-as-1900-students-with-disabilities-are-without-bus-service-on-first-day-of-school-violating-federal-law.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=b92e0a8f6a-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)
https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/08/cps-parents-in-tears-as-1900-students-with-disabilities-are-without-bus-service-on-first-day-of-school-violating-federal-law.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=b92e0a8f6a-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D
A school bus sits in front of a Chicago high school. (Stacey Rupolo for Chalkbeat)
By Illinois Review

On Monday, more than 1,900 Chicago Public School students with disabilities were without bus service on the first day of school as bus driver shortages left families in tears – a clear violation of Public Law 94-142 (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/08/cps-parents-in-tears-as-1900-students-with-disabilities-are-without-bus-service-on-first-day-of-school-violating-federal-law.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=b92e0a8f6a-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) known as the Education for All Handicapped Children Act of 1975.
CLICK TO READ FULL ARTICLE (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/08/cps-parents-in-tears-as-1900-students-with-disabilities-are-without-bus-service-on-first-day-of-school-violating-federal-law.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=b92e0a8f6a-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)
CPS officials have stated that over 8,800 students with disabilities have transportation to school, but claim that a bus driver shortage and an increase in the number of students with disabilities still leaves nearly 20 percent without bus transportation on the first day of school.

On Monday, district officials issued a statement,

“The District is dedicated to providing reliable transportation to all eligible students. Despite challenges like the national driver shortage and varied schedules, we remain focused on getting students to and from school safely and on time.”

However, PL 94-142 requires public schools to provide special education and related services – which includes bus transportation for children with disabilities ages 3-21. And failing to provide such services is a direct violation of federal law.

# [#]
Hey Peter, it's George.

Today we commemorate Women’s Equality Day, a national reminder of the women’s suffrage movement and the continued work to expand and secure equal rights today.

As we celebrate the anniversary of the 19th Amendment’s passage, we must call attention to women’s continuing efforts toward full equality.

Despite it being 2024, women are facing a barrage of attacks on their rights. From restrictions on reproductive healthcare and blatantly unequal wages, the fight for gender equality is far from over.

We must do everything in our power to prevent our nation from regressing and put all our energy toward progress and equity for every single individual.

Women’s rights are human rights, Peter. Until we eradicate gender discrimination, our nation will not know true equality. Progress in NY-16, and our country as a whole, means fighting for a woman’s right to choose, access to education, and fair wages in the workplace.

That’s why I’m putting real results over rhetoric, and fighting for New Yorkers across the board. I’m eager to get to Congress so I can continue making critical progress for underrepresented folks, but I need your help first, Peter. Can I count on you to pitch in $ or any amount today? Let me put it in perspective — we’re now just 46 days away from when folks will start receiving absentee ballots for the general election. That’s right — **_46_**. Meanwhile, we’ve got nearly **800,000 registered voters** to reach in every corner of the state, including thousands of folks who haven’t decided who they’re supporting this November. I can’t stress this enough: **_reaching these folks will determine whether or not we can give Gianforte the boot and take back the place we call home._** It’s not going to be cheap, and we’re already at a disadvantage running against a self-funded billionaire with rich buddies in his back pocket. body:
Elections are about the future...

It’s time to go on the OFFENSIVE.
| [](https://email.alert.keepcongressrepublican.com/c/eJyMkLGOnDAQhp_GdCAzNjYULi5BNNFF0TVXWsYeWO9ig2yTff2IZNOkSvvPzKf5_s93_W785uP63QRUD5t0yjo9s77vyZlYx70Oe0INFHhN-xqEZpVTbrDCiApVK4FL2jHZVjfVo7PcQOd6AYuYuaNUwEzZAHaZYYDKq4tDexDtwFromsHOHOcFFykc9twSTs2GqTQPxMPucU2Yc8LjnDdvTWzsHqpN3Uo5MmFvBCYCU0Z7JmyePiZ01waB6e7DHwECE2uRSSb7uUM-DLK7rth0lqCtCYfxayRs_PsXAXFNAjp_BsJGDMZvrzDvZ7JI2Pjxqb-8smIJG799_aj_Adg9FoyFsPHHW5WUO55-23wWknC6XszfKuV_G_-p4FcAAAD__7_Ahso)
---
Friend,
---
Over the last four years, the Democrats have pushed their radical agenda so outrageously far that our days, as Republicans, are endlessly spent simply having to stop their dangerous policies.
---
But with the 2024 election _less than 100 DAYS away_ , let me be crystal clear: the time for playing _defense_ is OVER.
---
I’m a fighter through and through, Friend; it’s just who I am. And believe me, the time has come for Republicans to go on **_OFFENSE!_**
---
Elections are about the _future_ ...
---
...And it’s time to follow President Trump’s lead and go on the _offensive_ , laying out our vision for a SAFE, SECURE, and PROSPEROUS American future.
---
But the House GOP’s offensive playbook simply wouldn’t be complete without input from grassroots patriots like _**YOU**_ – the lifeblood of the America First movement.
---
[**Please take the Official Survey:_“The Republican Offensive”_ to share YOUR top priorities with House GOP Leadership.**](https://email.alert.keepcongressrepublican.com/c/eJyMkLGOnDAQhp_GdCAzNjYULi5BNNFF0TVXWsYeWO9ig2yTff2IZNOkSvvPzKf5_s93_W785uP63QRUD5t0yjo9s77vyZlYx70Oe0INFHhN-xqEZpVTbrDCiApVK4FL2jHZVjfVo7PcQOd6AYuYuaNUwEzZAHaZYYDKq4tDexDtwFromsHOHOcFFykc9twSTs2GqTQPxMPucU2Yc8LjnDdvTWzsHqpN3Uo5MmFvBCYCU0Z7JmyePiZ01waB6e7DHwECE2uRSSb7uUM-DLK7rth0lqCtCYfxayRs_PsXAXFNAjp_BsJGDMZvrzDvZ7JI2Pjxqb-8smIJG799_aj_Adg9FoyFsPHHW5WUO55-23wWknC6XszfKuV_G_-p4FcAAAD__7_Ahso)

---

It’s not enough _just_ to fight back against Biden and the Democrats’ Election Interference.
---
**_We need to SECURE our elections for generations to come with voter ID laws and cleaned-up voter rolls._**
---
It’s not enough _just_ to hold the corrupt leftists and bureaucrats accountable.
---
**_We need to make YOUR government once again work for you – the PEOPLE._**
---
And it’s not enough _just_ to win in 2024, friend.
---
**_We need to win in a LANDSLIDE – defending our House majority, flipping the Senate, and taking back the White House to send a clear mandate to the Washington swamp._**
---
_But this offensive all begins with critical input from America First patriots like you._
---
[**So please, take the Official Survey:_“The Republican Offensive”_ to share YOUR top priorities with House GOP Leadership. **](https://email.alert.keepcongressrepublican.com/c/eJyMkLGOnDAQhp_GdCAzNjYULi5BNNFF0TVXWsYeWO9ig2yTff2IZNOkSvvPzKf5_s93_W785uP63QRUD5t0yjo9s77vyZlYx70Oe0INFHhN-xqEZpVTbrDCiApVK4FL2jHZVjfVo7PcQOd6AYuYuaNUwEzZAHaZYYDKq4tDexDtwFromsHOHOcFFykc9twSTs2GqTQPxMPucU2Yc8LjnDdvTWzsHqpN3Uo5MmFvBCYCU0Z7JmyePiZ01waB6e7DHwECE2uRSSb7uUM-DLK7rth0lqCtCYfxayRs_PsXAXFNAjp_BsJGDMZvrzDvZ7JI2Pjxqb-8smIJG799_aj_Adg9FoyFsPHHW5WUO55-23wWknC6XszfKuV_G_-p4FcAAAD__7_Ahso)

Our extremist, far-right Supreme Court is dangerous. It’s also one of the
most corrupt institutions across all branches of government.

For years, Supreme Court justices have accepted — and then failed to
disclose — massive gifts from parties with interests before the court.
This is corruption. But today, thanks to loopholes in the Court’s code of
ethics, it’s perfectly legal.

Justice Democrats Rep. Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez has introduced a bill to
change that. The High Court Gift Ban Act would put an end to legalized
bribery by creating and enforcing strict ethical standards for our highest
court.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140502?t=1002&akid=35939%2E1203867%2EWdCxfo ]Will you sign on to tell Congress to move forward with this critical

disastrous decisions made by the current bench, it is clear that they
aren’t afraid to wield it.

As we have come to learn the full extent of the Court’s bribery problem,

**Nella Domenici**
Republican for Senate

| **ABOUT NELLA**
**New Mexico is Nella Domenici’s home. She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years.

Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant.

Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. _Pennsylvania Suffragists in 1917_
It's Women's Equality Day – specifically 104 years since the 19th Amendment, which recognized women's right to vote, was enacted. Since then, we've made huge strides. Gaining access to birth control. Women being allowed to serve in combat. Colleges admitting women. Banning sexual harassment in our workplaces. But for the first time in history, we are moving backwards – women are LOSING our rights. In 2022, we lost the right to abortion care. And we've seen the devastating impact of that. 12-year-old girls forced to give birth. Pregnant patients turned away from ERs, pushed to the brink of death before they can get proper care. Mitch McConnell is flooding in millions of dollars to smear my record and boost his handpicked candidate. Unfortunately, these attacks are working: **The latest polls have this race wide open.**

Look, I’ve never been your typical politician. I’m a farmer. I grew up in a twenty-four-by-thirty-six foot house. I still farm the land my parents homesteaded 100 years ago. (Sharla and I are harvesting as we speak.)

I try every day to do right by the people of Montana. That means standing up to anybody—including Mitch McConnell and his special interests—to improve health care for veterans, lower prescription drug costs, and protect Medicare and Social Security.

[ stdin# ][IMG]

It was our 8th birthday this weekend,
Peter Willis! After Bernie ran for
president in 2016, he founded Our Revolution to keep the fight for
progressive change going. And to celebrate, we’re offering you a little
gift when you make a small dollar donation.

Bernie’s campaign sparked a movement for an economy that works for all of
us, election reforms that empower the people, not billionaires and
corporations, and so much more. We’ve advanced this progressive agenda in
local, state and federal governments, and the Democratic Party platform.
And we’ve helped elect over 1,000 progressive elected officials.

It all started with Bernie. Together, we can keep it going through
November to defeat Donald Trump and his extreme Project 2025 agenda while
electing progressives up and down the ballot. We can continue pressuring
our elected officials for the action that the people need — like an end to
the war on Gaza, health care for all, expanding Social Security, and
ending the influence of big money in our elections.

Our movement is making an impact, and we can’t let up now.

Harris just released an economic plan that directly tackles housing,
medical debt, corporate price gouging, and the cost of living for working
families — and we know we can encourage a Harris-Walz administration to go
even bolder.

We know we have a lot of adversaries trying to stop our movement. The
billionaire class is spending massive amounts of money on elections and
lobbying to block progressive change. AIPAC pledged to spend $100 million
against pro-Peace progressives by November, and the right-wing pro-Israel
lobby defeated Cori Bush and Jamaal Bowman. And Donald Trump will continue
to rally his corporate friends on Wall Street and in Big Oil to try to
implement his dangerous policies.

As the largest grassroots progressive political organization in the
country, we rely on your small-dollar contributions to fight back against
big corporate money, right-wing extremism, and the billionaire class.

name: Ruben Gallego
subject: The American Dream is alive
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Gallego for Arizona
body:
This is a picture of my mom and my three sisters watching me speak at the DNC on Thursday night. My immigrant mother raised the four of us on a secretary’s salary.
#

The American Dream is alive, Peter.
Just look:
[](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-august24.kZit_I&refcode=em240826-3-160&t=1&akid=2959%2E734936%2E1LGOAd)
This is a picture of my mom and my three sisters watching me speak at the DNC on Thursday night.
My immigrant mother raised the four of us on a secretary’s salary. I worked any job I could get to support the family. I slept on the floor, on the couch, on a roll-out mattress. I got into Harvard with no money, no connections. I fought in Iraq. And now, I’m running for the U.S. Senate in Arizona.
I believed it when I was a kid, and I believe it now:**Anything is possible in the United States of America.**
But there is no denying that the American Dream feels out of reach for far too many.
Kari Lake won’t fix that, and Trump won’t either. They’ll divide us further, cut taxes for their billionaire friends, and leave an economy that works for them — not working families, not the middle class.
It is up to us to keep the American Dream alive — to defend it, to strengthen it. And the best way we can do that right now is by defeating Trump and Kari Lake.
[**So, I’m asking you to make a donation to my campaign today. Whatever you can afford, even a donation as small as $1. Yes, even $1. No donation is too small in a campaign as close as this one, and these add up fast when everyone is chipping in.**](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-august24.kZit_I&refcode=em240826-3-160&t=2&akid=2959%2E734936%2E1LGOAd)

Friends-
Today, we honor and celebrate Women's Equality Day. This year marks 104 years since the 19th Amendment gave women the right to vote on August 26th, 1920. The Voting Rights Act of 1965 was the last voting rights act to be passed on the federal level, and many Americans today are still fighting for their right to vote. As we approach election season, we cannot forget the importance of every woman's right to vote and how recently it came to be.
So much of the work we are able to do is a direct result of voting, and we need you to help us continue that work. We are already preparing for statewide elections in 2026, and a contribution from you today will ensure we can help get out the vote and elect a legislature that will fight for affordability.
