subject: Fraudsters Beware! As Auditor, I'm Guarding Our Grands
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY JAMES BROWN FOR MONTANA—REPUBLICAN—LORNA KUNEY, TREASURERPO BOX 1585, HELENA, MT 59624
body:
With Montana roots four generations deep, affordability and protection of our lifestyle is my commitment. | | | | |
---
|
---
| As a proud 4th generation Montanan, I know the importance of protecting the Montana way of life. This includes the need to keep Montana affordable for Montana’s working families and safeguarding seniors from fraudsters.
Incredibly, the U.S. Government Accountability Office recently reported that scams are a significant and growing problem for individuals and businesses. They noted that scams involving fake investment opportunities rose from $3.31 billion in 2022 to $4.57 billion in 2023. Many of these scams are targeting Montana’s vulnerable populations. This is a situation that needs to be addressed and immediately.
---
[CLICK HERE TO DONATE TODAY! ](https://gmail.us22.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e42c6bb78e8b53de5ee6ec610&id=ba964ec500&e=80cd3574a3)
| Montana law designates the state auditor as the primary elected official responsible for combating insurance and securities fraud. As your next state auditor, I will vigilantly serve you as Montana’s watchdog and zealously prosecute bad actors. However, I can’t go to battle for you without first winning this important constitutional office And, that takes resources. Can you help me protect Montana’s seniors by providing a generous contribution of $750, $300, $100 or even $50 dollars today? Though I hold a Montana insurance producer’s license, unlike some previous candidates for this important office, I am not an insurance industry insider. I have spent my entire career defending the interests of consumers and investors and will continue to do so in this key position. I have zero tolerance for those who violate the law or attempt to financially abuse seniors and other vulnerable groups. I will work to create a regulatory environment that is fair to entities willing to provide much-needed insurance coverage to Montanans. Contrast my proven record of success with that of my opponents’ record. My opponent has publicly admitted he has a “progressive vision” for Montana – a vision that will important “woke” values to the Treasure State and a vision that will make your insurance policies even more costly than they are today. As your Auditor, I pledge to hold insurers accountable for refusing to write property insurance in areas of Montana due to perceived wildfire risk. Further, I will fight to ensure those with pre-existing conditions receive the care they need and ensure the zealous prosecution of white-collar criminals. Most importantly, I love Montana. That’s why, as your next Auditor, I will always put Montana first. You have my sincerest thanks for helping me to stand up for Montana’s values. You can contribute $500, $100 or $50 today online by visiting [jamesbrownformontana.com](https://gmail.us22.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e42c6bb78e8b53de5ee6ec610&id=2b38e7a601&e=80cd3574a3) God bless,
James Brown

---
Earlier today we sent you an email asking you to imagine how you'd feel watching the election results and seeing Kamala Harris win and Democrats control Congress. Now imagine the opposite. You're watching the results of the election and Donald Trump wins states like Pennsylvania and Michigan early. It's over. He's coming back to the White House, and because of the bad results in those two states, he'll have the House and the Senate with him. Supreme Court justices will be his to nominate. Four more years. There's one word for it: Pain. We're sorry to put that thought in your head, but the good news is that it doesn't have to be that way. You just have to do your part. Because if we can reach our fundraising goals, we can persuade the people we need to reach before they vote and turn out the ones we know will vote our way before Election Day. If we do that, Democrats will win. But back to your part. We need your help to reach those budget goals. Peter — I know Kamala Harris. When I served as Attorney General of North Carolina, she served California in the same role. As Governor and Vice President, we’ve worked closely to advance the Biden-Harris administration’s agenda and deliver the results North Carolinians elected us to achieve. I championed bills to invest in early childhood education, increase mental health services, and boost salaries to keep experienced educators in the classroom. That’s why the educators in Anne Arundel, Howard, and Carroll Counties endorsed my candidacy early in this race.

Peter -- this is for your eyes only.

As Nella Domenici’s campaign manager, I’ve been closely monitoring our internal polling numbers. We’re on a pathway to victory here in New Mexico, but I wanted to share an inside look at what we’re seeing.

I’ll be frank--**right now, our biggest barrier is being underfunded.** We risk our opponent outspending us and controlling the message on TV. He’s a 20-year incumbent who has stacks of campaign cash, while Nella is a first-time candidate who is personally investing in this race.

Nella is running because she wants better for New Mexico and feels, just as we all do, that Martin Heinrich is failing us.

Peter, here are the key takeaways:

State of the Race:
New Mexico Senate

1. **_This is a resource campaign._** Ad spending will dramatically affect the outcome of this race. If we are underfunded, it will give the Democrats a leg up.

2. There are a large number of “undecideds” in this race, and they favor Nella. _**It’s now up to us to convert undecided voters to Nella.**_

3. **Heinrich has no room to grow.** More New Mexicans know who he is and know he has failed to perform. More New Mexicans agree (45%-34%) that “Martin Heinrich has failed New Mexico.”

4. While Democrats are seeing a honeymoon phase after Joe Biden’s announcement of dropping out, Nella has not only held her numbers, but actually __**improved**__ among Republicans _**without sacrificing appeal to Independent voters.**_

Now, I am going to ask you to bet on New Mexico. There are so many critical races, [**but just $5 can make a huge difference in this one.**](http://links.nellanewmexico.com/u/click?_t=bec4f693b6284a4ba56cb04ba05e5b45&_m=1521c4569d1049f78cb683dcd73b14a5&_e=UulIOhIU5VHaCc-ELq0Z5F2zz_1UJrXDwG-mmKzgY9KT-jiBoKl430C9-Iv1VMrL80mtJkFv7mm0vSYPdAw1ih4zismnCjLqdcoiyvXtAs4AxI9QCPcWx-inYLtZgN7FtTxZqkMyUOudZ9ZzOa2IZoAAJIreiGgHHPUmW7O4OEk7EGirwhOEPN8XbM-qEvnBB0Qq_Jmh057IfwQtbLHptV9dyhOVttCoF_f8U6h2Jb2cdJ7TWhn_MUbpNCZtgmWsIkMQ2l79mxurmZ_deJl0jiS-2c7xgf2_7LnGikqyWrMOjQSxtXu26eQmgIvniQ-mPnA7G4jL8BBI_DM9VJiEeSSNO88tqMBD_ZLx_S6gxix7ytDtfhgeEREMya35HuDnBKaI6lzKvgRknF25-zZtE_aYIuJyAhNTFUtyfjVtzxY%3D) We aren’t seeing the national attention on this Senate race, so your support today goes that much further.

A TV ad running in Albuquerque will cost almost $750,000 less than the same ad running in Phoenix – and a Senate seat counts the same here, or anywhere in the country. That’s why your investment here can truly have an outsized impact on this election.

[**Every dollar really does make a difference here.**](http://links.nellanewmexico.com/u/click?_t=bec4f693b6284a4ba56cb04ba05e5b45&_m=1521c4569d1049f78cb683dcd73b14a5&_e=UulIOhIU5VHaCc-ELq0Z5F2zz_1UJrXDwG-mmKzgY9KT-jiBoKl430C9-Iv1VMrL80mtJkFv7mm0vSYPdAw1ih4zismnCjLqdcoiyvXtAs4AxI9QCPcWx-inYLtZgN7FtTxZqkMyUOudZ9ZzOa2IZoAAJIreiGgHHPUmW7O4OEk7EGirwhOEPN8XbM-qEvnBB0Qq_Jmh057IfwQtbLHptV9dyhOVttCoF_f8U6h2Jb2cdJ7TWhn_MUbpNCZtgmWsIkMQ2l79mxurmZ_deJl0jk7tZVhGx8GyqS1w-JIVz9Zi4SCvXnh-qk_uQnou5K343wgOuEcoM-ZCkICTpXWpcY2uphplBc1DB8KiE_UgT0nA-Mylbr2qeVxSrhEEVGhyfsNXpgxqDAp9gdRJhBBSWztmDr0O0pdNrxyrlVagon4%3D)

| **ABOUT NELLA**
**New Mexico is Nella Domenici’s home. She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years.

Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant.

Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. Collectively, the companies Nella has been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans.

Like her father and mother, Nella has been a warrior for those who most need an advocate: for women competing in academics or business, for families dealing with mental illness, and for those without access to quality healthcare or education. **

clean_body: As Nella Domenici’s campaign manager, I wanted to give you an inside look at some of the latest internal polling. | Peter -- this is for your eyes only. As Nella Domenici’s campaign manager, I’ve been closely monitoring our internal polling numbers. We’re on a pathway to victory here in New Mexico, but I wanted to share an inside look at what we’re seeing. I’ll be frank--right now, our biggest barrier is being underfunded. We risk our opponent outspending us and controlling the message on TV. He’s a 20-year incumbent who has stacks of campaign cash, while Nella is a first-time candidate who is personally investing in this race. Nella is running because she wants better for New Mexico and feels, just as we all do, that Martin Heinrich is failing us. Peter, here are the key takeaways: State of the Race: New Mexico Senate 1. This is a resource campaign. Ad spending will dramatically affect the outcome of this race. If we are underfunded, it will give the Democrats a leg up. 2. There are a large number of “undecideds” in this race, and they favor Nella. It’s now up to us to convert undecided voters to Nella. 3. Heinrich has no room to grow. More New Mexicans know who he is and know he has failed to perform. More New Mexicans agree (45%-34%) that “Martin Heinrich has failed New Mexico.” 4. While Democrats are seeing a honeymoon phase after Joe Biden’s announcement of dropping out, Nella has not only held her numbers, but actually improved among Republicans without sacrificing appeal to Independent voters. Now, I am going to ask you to bet on New Mexico. There are so many critical races, We aren’t seeing the national attention on this Senate race, so your support today goes that much further. A TV ad running in Albuquerque will cost almost $750,000 less than the same ad running in Phoenix – and a Senate seat counts the same here, or anywhere in the country. That’s why your investment here can truly have an outsized impact on this election. With your support, we can flip this seat and retire Martin Heinrich for good. Thanks, Noah Jennings Campaign Manager, Nella for Senate | ABOUT NELLA New Mexico is Nella Domenici’s home. She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years. Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant. Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. Collectively, the companies Nella has been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans. Like her father and mother, Nella has been a warrior for those who most need an advocate: for women competing in academics or business, for families dealing with mental illness, and for those without access to quality healthcare or education. # FROM THE DESK OF LARRY KUDLOW
---
| | Reader,**I am pleased to share with you that The New York Sun, one of my daily must-read papers, is now the exclusive publisher of my regular columns.

I invite you to consider joining the Sun to receive unlimited access to my latest commentary, alongside some of the finest American journalism.

**But there's also far more to what the Sun is building.

As you know, journalism isn't what it used to be.

I've been in the business for decades, and never before have I seen this once noble profession so abused. The major papers are no longer on the side of the American people, and we are right to withhold our trust.

The impact on our democracy is considerable. Without real accountability, the worst actors in government and at corporate institutions have free reign, and patriotic, hard-working Americans are being sidelined and ignored.

The antidote is to join the movement to build a better alternative. That's the American way.

**The charge to restore American journalism is being led by the Sun.** A proudly all-American, principled publication that has plenty of room for conservative thought and conservative writers, the Sun has upheld the highest journalistic standards since 1833. That's 18 years before the New York Times published its first number.**My decision for the New York Sun to become the exclusive publisher of my regular columns was not taken lightly.**

I value their work and have been impressed by their team, but I know they have a hell of a battle ahead. They are the David facing many Goliaths.

They will only succeed if we join with them in this grassroots national effort. Joining the Sun costs as little as a penny a day. I encourage you to sign up today. Every single person counts.

body:
Another DNC attack on democracy defeated!

| | | [ ](https://www.jillstein2024.com/?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=wisconsin_win&n=1)
---
Peter, Great news: the Wisconsin Supreme Court just ruled that the DNC is “not entitled” to keep Jill Stein and Butch Ware off the ballot in Wisconsin. In other words, we just beat back _another_ attack on democracy by the anti-Democratic Party! [**Please help us celebrate by pitching in anything you can to get Jill and Butch on the ballot in the final states where we’re petitioning now:**](https://www.jillstein2024.com/ba?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=wisconsin_win&n=2)
---
| [](https://www.jillstein2024.com/ba?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=wisconsin_win&n=3 "GET JILL AND BUTCH ON THE BALLOT") [GET JILL AND BUTCH ON THE BALLOT](https://www.jillstein2024.com/ba?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=wisconsin_win&n=3)
---
[ ](https://www.jillstein2024.com/ba?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=wisconsin_win&n=4)
---
Just last week, Michelle Obama announced from the DNC stage that Democrats “don’t cheat others to get ahead” and “don’t change the rules so we always win” - at the same time the DNC was suing in Wisconsin to try to kick us off the ballot! We believe that if the Democrats had succeeded with this lawsuit, it would have forced the Wisconsin Elections Commission to remove not only the Green Party, but also the Libertarian Party and Constitution Party presidential candidates. The Dems’ war on democracy has one goal: _entrenching the two parties of war and Wall Street by making sure voters like you don’t have any other choice._ **Thanks to supporters like you, we’re fighting back and winning critical victories for real democracy.** But the fight is far from over. We’re still working 24/7 to get Jill and Butch on the ballot in states around the country so that we can give _as many voters as possible_ a real choice for people, planet, and peace. To get Jill and Butch on the ballot in the final states with upcoming deadlines, we still need to raise just over $21,000. With your help, we can do it today. [_**Will you pitch in now to help celebrate our big win for democracy in Wisconsin and keep building momentum?**_](https://www.jillstein2024.com/ba?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=wisconsin_win&n=5)
---
| [](https://www.jillstein2024.com/ba?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=wisconsin_win&n=6 "DONATE FOR DEMOCRACY") [DONATE FOR DEMOCRACY](https://www.jillstein2024.com/ba?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=wisconsin_win&n=6)
---
Thank you for everything you do to power our fight for an America and a world that works for all of us! In solidarity and gratitude, Team Stein/Ware 2024

Hi Peter,
**We had an incredible time at the DNC last week — Care in Action put the care agenda front and center!**
Our care worker leaders Dionne Davis and Emma Biggs were in attendance all week, connecting with other movement leaders and elected officials.
[](https://click.everyaction.com/k/91579579/494302867/-1177098384?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNV08vMS83NjczNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3ZGZkODVlZi1mYzYzLWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkYmZjNGIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Iu1zJR8wly-nihuSBoNjvx6owWOuADSmEZno6LhkqA0=&emci=c754ca10-f263-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&emdi=7dfd85ef-fc63-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&ceid=864787)
Here’s a quick recap of some highlights from this week of action, solidarity, and community:
**_MONDAY_**
We honored the accomplishments of the care coalition at the **Care Can’t Wait Action: Skyline Soiree** , giving toasts to the fearless Care Champions, workers, and advocates working tirelessly to build a future where care workers are fully valued and supported.
[](https://click.everyaction.com/k/91579581/494302869/-1177098384?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNV08vMS83NjczNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3ZGZkODVlZi1mYzYzLWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkYmZjNGIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Iu1zJR8wly-nihuSBoNjvx6owWOuADSmEZno6LhkqA0=&emci=c754ca10-f263-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&emdi=7dfd85ef-fc63-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&ceid=864787)
**_TUESDAY_**
Our Senior Advisor Ai‐jen Poo was featured at the **Women’s Caucus** , where our Care pins were the in demand item.
[](https://click.everyaction.com/k/91579582/494302872/-1177098384?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNV08vMS83NjczNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3ZGZkODVlZi1mYzYzLWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkYmZjNGIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Iu1zJR8wly-nihuSBoNjvx6owWOuADSmEZno6LhkqA0=&emci=c754ca10-f263-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&emdi=7dfd85ef-fc63-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&ceid=864787)
We hosted **Our Economy Runs on Care: Care Can’t Wait** , an official DNC panel of care movement leaders, caregivers, and Members of Congress who spoke about their personal experiences and their commitment to passing a care agenda.
“We are a movement that is fighting for **affordable quality childcare**. We are fighting for **paid family and medical leave** so we can take time to care for ourselves and the people we love when we need to. And we're fighting for **affordable, quality, aging and disability care** for every single person in this country so that we can all live, work, age, and care with dignity.

These are issues that are so powerful that they touch everyone.

**That's why we're building an incredibly powerful force for change to vote in November and to get this agenda across the finish line.”**

\- Ai-jen Poo, Care in Action Senior Advisor
---
**_WEDNESDAY_**
We hosted Care in Action’s **House of Power** — built for and by women organizing to shape the future of democracy and forge a more compassionate, intersectional, equitable nation.
[](https://click.everyaction.com/k/91579583/494302873/-1177098384?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNV08vMS83NjczNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3ZGZkODVlZi1mYzYzLWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkYmZjNGIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Iu1zJR8wly-nihuSBoNjvx6owWOuADSmEZno6LhkqA0=&emci=c754ca10-f263-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&emdi=7dfd85ef-fc63-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&ceid=864787)
The House of Power held two events:
**1\. Winning & Delivering on Democracy, Abortion, and Care** — featuring speakers including director Ava DuVernay, Michigan Governor Gretchen Whitmer, Sen. Laphonza Butler, and movement leaders.
[](https://click.everyaction.com/k/91579584/494302874/-1177098384?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNV08vMS83NjczNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3ZGZkODVlZi1mYzYzLWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkYmZjNGIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Iu1zJR8wly-nihuSBoNjvx6owWOuADSmEZno6LhkqA0=&emci=c754ca10-f263-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&emdi=7dfd85ef-fc63-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&ceid=864787)
**2\. Celebration of Firsts Party** — a celebration featuring speakers from the care coalition including Dionne and Emma, and actress and comedian Cristela Alonzo.
**_THURSDAY_**
Our Senior Advisor Ai-jen Poo participated in the **Reaching the Latino Vote panel** with Health and Human Services Secretary Xavier Becerra, Tucson Mayor Regina Romero, and Vote Latino President Maria Teresa Kumar. The conservation touched on reaching Latino voters, the economy, and the importance of passing the care agenda.
[](https://click.everyaction.com/k/91579585/494302875/-1177098384?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNV08vMS83NjczNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3ZGZkODVlZi1mYzYzLWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkYmZjNGIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Iu1zJR8wly-nihuSBoNjvx6owWOuADSmEZno6LhkqA0=&emci=c754ca10-f263-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&emdi=7dfd85ef-fc63-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&ceid=864787)
During DNC Night Four, Governor Gretchen Whitmer spoke on the mainstage about joining the **sandwich generation** — working hard while raising her newborn and caring for her mother. Too many Americans are stuck in this predicament without receiving the support they need to succeed.
Actress Kerry Washington **shouted out care workers:**
“For our children, for our parents, for our teachers, for our care workers who treat our loved ones like their own, for working families who make this country thrive!”
---

Fellow Conservative,

As a former Navy SEAL and combat veteran, I’ve seen my fair share of battle. Between my and my wife’s service to our country, we’ve sacrificed years of our lives to make America a more safe and prosperous nation and to protect our God-given freedoms and liberties. We served so that our children and yours might grow up to realize their own American Dreams.

Duty to country. Service and sacrifice over self, **those are the traits that define me**. I’m proud of the work we did for our country. That said, the events of August 2021 rocked me to my core and ultimately led me to **[launch a campaign for the United States Senate last June.](http://links.justandfreegop.com/u/click?_t=8ca5ef3d31cc43bcb1fbe6968d953911&_m=fb6ec9acea094700b51ddcb00feb73d1&_e=bzaKcRFIBY2_w4Y9YmPsYjjjgiiSxrGf8agdjVe9ifyv7bowT2lRc1vLHCD3fT7z-0e4tX1ZAlv9DrXnquu3V8060FoJ5Uj953l2oL7Gi9L_qp7mRsUT53cvy-hJY1BfcT-3XpyMcXIihDk1L189-dJtUyU8MsJl1oxqc7U-WM1P-qiH9al8Hj8Z99hMXT6xK9-o-B1eWOxB81j_sXx6xGZqxJU57kDwPRzhDGmzzAPtod7FcvtLTzyDjctZPaPaKO9mn0z7O5EH7GNQ_yCn-S7BOkCIc3WsbON_IpqXsKJ7q4XScQn9HZNETvvWoRBgq1m9RXVGe2kBF5bUplzVHAgA3WlXwH4LeWDF5_NbdJ-AmqMCm-DFbuR3TQDEFDVyhIeq1SHFGHI09KbzE1kahfvyW3Mw26vPVOQGu71bIO4%3D)**

In August 2021, I was putting out wildfires in California by day as part of the aerial firefighting company that I run; by night, my colleagues [_**many veterans like me**_] and I were working the phones trying to get our friends and allies out of Afghanistan before the takeover by the Taliban. I remember vividly that at one point I was trying to help an ally **sneak through a tunnel to get him and his family to the airport** so that they could be evacuated on a U.S. military aircraft. The Taliban wanted these high-value targets dead; they wanted their families dead.

[](http://links.justandfreegop.com/u/click?_t=8ca5ef3d31cc43bcb1fbe6968d953911&_m=fb6ec9acea094700b51ddcb00feb73d1&_e=bzaKcRFIBY2_w4Y9YmPsYjjjgiiSxrGf8agdjVe9ifyv7bowT2lRc1vLHCD3fT7z-0e4tX1ZAlv9DrXnquu3V8060FoJ5Uj953l2oL7Gi9L_qp7mRsUT53cvy-hJY1BfcT-3XpyMcXIihDk1L189-dJtUyU8MsJl1oxqc7U-WM1P-qiH9al8Hj8Z99hMXT6xK9-o-B1eWOxB81j_sXx6xGZqxJU57kDwPRzhDGmzzAPtod7FcvtLTzyDjctZPaPaKO9mn0z7O5EH7GNQ_yCn-eQjmVyxkYkuT3xFkDofwKoK4XecgpLPsP31vDJ0IcWqTlkP3su-oPUAAlQjIm51X_3YGwagSmZLqfmP5Tw1grEShTG8aVy_GY2nr0-uED3d4BBNbuMH6rbCdVTsC2kTdAcYj2qeXjq1z15vJQnsWuI%3D)
This continued for days. Throughout the entire process, _**“I kept thinking to myself, “The adult will come in the room and say, ‘Hey, this is a disaster; we’re going to stop this.’”**_

Every day it got worse.
Every day it was a disaster.
The adult in the room never materialized.

**Then, 13 Americans were vaporized at the gate to Kabul’s airport.** Billions of dollars in military and human assets were left behind – all so Joe Biden and Kamala Harris could get a press conference saying that he’d pulled the country out of an “endless war.”

I had sat in the homes of the families that we were frantically trying to get out; I had promised them that we weren’t going to leave them behind. _**So, you can imagine the dishonor that I felt**_ because of the promises we weren’t able to keep to the people who’d sacrificed so much to help us combat evil.

**If you're thinking this email is on the longer side, you're right.** If you're short on time and unable to finish reading to the end right now, **[please do me a quick favor and confirm that I have the correct information on file for you](http://links.justandfreegop.com/u/click?_t=8ca5ef3d31cc43bcb1fbe6968d953911&_m=fb6ec9acea094700b51ddcb00feb73d1&_e=bzaKcRFIBY2_w4Y9YmPsYjjjgiiSxrGf8agdjVe9ifyv7bowT2lRc1vLHCD3fT7zy9NQL0EDCuRlsn5AqBONIhEXitVjb4A5ON3e-DPIt4lboDnwjstFjX5vddPegsp3OBMQkAm20Z6hjJ1f8Q-wZdRtRFGANCAiJltQCKsYi5QqkIWNWzuj4xUIk_UaWnCqrKNLOw7rOdU7xKpYaxmzOj7lVPpQamS1bC3N-B3vEsnp2CeP9ezeDHAyxxPJYU05Sa0asYU374ZRtbJb5Ysft86RTuxwp0UcMe2Ph1mlXQKy02TPjmIYhxWKgorr0ixva2vUGMO5UGzCilYne6uoYRhf2cO753_Xv638PDrtqvxs8v6HkPbnGKN-0tQxF3i5O846Ct4oMjXNqoSSDCwtwzkniA80W4g7RaMyi4lU4YE%3D)** ; my opponent and his allies will not make winning this seat easy.

It was in the aftermath of the fall of Afghanistan that I ever truly considered entering politics. Deciding to launch a campaign for the United States Senate wasn’t an easy decision; **but the United States needs leaders who understand the sacrifice it’s taken to build our country. When your country calls and needs you, you have to answer. **

[](http://links.justandfreegop.com/u/click?_t=8ca5ef3d31cc43bcb1fbe6968d953911&_m=fb6ec9acea094700b51ddcb00feb73d1&_e=bzaKcRFIBY2_w4Y9YmPsYjjjgiiSxrGf8agdjVe9ifyv7bowT2lRc1vLHCD3fT7z-0e4tX1ZAlv9DrXnquu3V8060FoJ5Uj953l2oL7Gi9L_qp7mRsUT53cvy-hJY1BfcT-3XpyMcXIihDk1L189-dJtUyU8MsJl1oxqc7U-WM1P-qiH9al8Hj8Z99hMXT6xK9-o-B1eWOxB81j_sXx6xGZqxJU57kDwPRzhDGmzzAPtod7FcvtLTzyDjctZPaPaKO9mn0z7O5EH7GNQ_yCn-fn2EWgd1dtcETBMoV3rbC-JBR0ioTEdYEtTrnd4cNP2eONWL5ILu6c60MLOgdMZ6LvLCb6o0mQv2_52BBC8zm8lRHRU7wKqQJs0F8AenN_OHs2yAJqJRAHhQwqY_DIKK9-zkbETTv99lKCQHXWhR38%3D)
**Unlike Joe Biden and Kamala Harris, I understand what it is to serve our country. Not service in politics, but on the battlefield.** I’ve been wounded in service of our nation; I’ve lost mentors and friends who were willing to make the ultimate sacrifice so that future generations will be free. [**ENLIST WITH TIM
CONFIRM YOUR SUPPORT TODAY->** ](http://links.justandfreegop.com/u/click?_t=8ca5ef3d31cc43bcb1fbe6968d953911&_m=fb6ec9acea094700b51ddcb00feb73d1&_e=bzaKcRFIBY2_w4Y9YmPsYjjjgiiSxrGf8agdjVe9ifyv7bowT2lRc1vLHCD3fT7z-0e4tX1ZAlv9DrXnquu3V8060FoJ5Uj953l2oL7Gi9L_qp7mRsUT53cvy-hJY1BfcT-3XpyMcXIihDk1L189-dJtUyU8MsJl1oxqc7U-WM1P-qiH9al8Hj8Z99hMXT6xK9-o-B1eWOxB81j_sXx6xGZqxJU57kDwPRzhDGmzzAPtod7FcvtLTzyDjctZPaPaKO9mn0z7O5EH7GNQ_yCn-WExKJviaHIWjNvvHpas-vPFCno-OeH7KKkfEyWGFuWCrz2GmhMnJIUqmvhfK7Zbj-3d2tKYx9SmDgkN78m87L96mUuS_SGEeYre-jecDr9GY3wuNeMn8ksOZW0YJrNsdUrPLq8vIDiJxYEZRolVI9g%3D)

I’m reaching out to you today because if this campaign to flip Montana’s U.S. Senate seat is going to be successful, **[I’m going to need the help of every conservative donor who reads this letter.](http://links.justandfreegop.com/u/click?_t=8ca5ef3d31cc43bcb1fbe6968d953911&_m=fb6ec9acea094700b51ddcb00feb73d1&_e=bzaKcRFIBY2_w4Y9YmPsYjjjgiiSxrGf8agdjVe9ifyv7bowT2lRc1vLHCD3fT7z-0e4tX1ZAlv9DrXnquu3V8060FoJ5Uj953l2oL7Gi9L_qp7mRsUT53cvy-hJY1BfcT-3XpyMcXIihDk1L189-dJtUyU8MsJl1oxqc7U-WM1P-qiH9al8Hj8Z99hMXT6xK9-o-B1eWOxB81j_sXx6xGZqxJU57kDwPRzhDGmzzAPtod7FcvtLTzyDjctZPaPaKO9mn0z7O5EH7GNQ_yCn-SM_9uyc1RpLHuLG20YJRG3cqBCk7CQtZ5Rm7s-Mfhh00UzlONmqHoieZ_dhUJNSEios97TswjPQ0G4-8fe5YaPhivhGej7a9w9EpeQKyadLdQiOnGox8-vnU1YXrGkY-PZnutz3ytBg_Q1mFKGb0Og%3D) **

Twice in a row, Joe Biden has pulled us out of two wars for political purposes.

We fought in Iraq, _**I was there.**_ We fought in Afghanistan, _**I was there.**_
